data.jd_text:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in technical program management, with a focus on infrastructure projects.
* 5 years of experience in a leadership role with direct reports.
* Experience in both fiber optic network design/deployment (OSP) and data center infrastructure (ISP).


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 10 years of multi\-disciplinary experience in network, fiber, electrical, and mechanical (cooling) systems.
* Experience working with global carriers and stakeholders in the EMEA and APAC telecommunications and data center markets.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to navigate through ambiguity and build consensus among high\-level executive stakeholders.
* Proven track record in New Product Initiatives (NPI), specifically in defining standards for deployable infrastructure solutions.


**About The Job**
 Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage various Engineering\-specific programs and teams.
   

  

 The Fiber Infrastructure Engineering and Delivery team is a unified organization within Google Global Infrastructure, integrating the expertise of capacity infrastructure engineering, network infrastructure engineering, and fiber and capacity delivery. Our mission is to deliver the resilient long\-haul and metro fiber assets and data center network space that power Google's global growth and AI leadership. We operate at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and global scale, ensuring Google’s network infrastructure is the most reliable and efficient on the planet.
   

  

 This role requires approximately 25% travel, mostly to Google’s data centers around the globe.
   

  

 Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Orchestrate program strategy across East EU and MENA to drive consistency and economies of scale. Be able to strengthen alignment between technical requirements and business objectives by providing advanced insights facilitating executive decision\-making.
* Define requirements for the Google Global Network, designing data center infrastructure (space, power, cooling) and define new product deployment globally.
* Manage complex relationships globally. Influence and collaborate with design engineering firms, carriers, internal engineering teams, and senior executives to solve large\-scale network growth challenges.
* Establish systems to identify and implement innovative solutions that optimize project delivery. Manage risks and drive improvements in lead\-time, predictability, and cost\-effectiveness.
* Lead a global team of technical program managers. Foster growth mindset and culture of learning, ensuring the team's skills are transferable across technical domains.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.jd_text:
A high\-growth, multi\-asset trading group is hiring a Head of Product \& PMO to lead the performance of its trading ecosystem and the execution of strategic initiatives across global operations. The business runs two regulated trading platforms covering FX, CFDs and equities on one side, and crypto spot, perpetual futures, margin and copy trading on the other, serving retail, high\-net\-worth and institutional clients across multiple jurisdictions.
 



  





 This is a dual mandate sitting at the intersection of commercial product leadership and disciplined programme delivery. You will own the product P\&L across crypto and traditional asset classes, shape monetisation strategy, and stand up the PMO function that governs how initiatives are planned, prioritised and delivered across the group.
 



  





**What you will lead** 



* Product strategy and monetisation across all trading products, with continuous refinement based on performance data, competitor moves and market dynamics.
* Full product P\&L ownership across crypto and traditional offerings, driving revenue growth, profitability and unit economics across every product line.
* Establishment and leadership of the PMO function, including governance frameworks, standardised processes, reporting and delivery tracking across all strategic initiatives.
* User acquisition, activation, retention and lifetime value strategy, with constant optimisation of user journeys, trading activity and product stickiness.
* Pricing architecture across trading fees, spreads and liquidity incentive structures, balancing competitiveness with revenue optimisation.
* Data\-driven experimentation and delivery measurement, with structured frameworks for both product and programme outcomes.
* Cross\-functional alignment across Trading, Technology, Marketing, Sales and Operations, ensuring the PMO drives genuine coordination rather than reporting overhead.
* Global expansion and regional product adaptation, maintaining global consistency while tuning for local market fit.
* Leadership and scaling of both the Product and PMO teams, with clear KPIs, accountability and a high\-performance culture.



  





**What we are looking for** 



* 8 to 12\+ years in product management and/or programme management, ideally within crypto, trading, FinTech or financial services. Proven track record of owning product P\&L and delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives. Strong understanding of trading platforms, market structures and monetisation. Experience establishing or running PMO functions and delivery frameworks. Data\-driven analytical mindset. Track record of leading high\-performing product and project teams in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments.
* Preferred: exposure across both crypto and traditional financial products, deep understanding of trading behaviour, liquidity and execution dynamics, multi\-market product and delivery experience, and fluency with Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methodologies.



  





**Location** 




 Dubai, onsite. Relocation supported
 








**PACKAGE** 




**Base salary in the region of USD 120,000 to 130,000 per annum, paid in AED. Performance\-related annual bonus. ESOP participation. Standard UAE benefits**

**Job Description**
 Parsons is seeking an exceptional
 **Program Direc** 
**tor** 
 to lead the delivery of a landmark multi\-stage, multi\-discipline rail consultancy programme in the UAE. In this role you will serve as the principal representative of the Parsons\-led consultancy team, accountable to the Client for all aspects of programme delivery across all project stages: Feasibility and Concept Design, Preliminary Design, Tender Documentation and Design \& Construct Contract Award, Design Review and Contract Administration, and Defects Liability and Project Close\-Out. The role demands a thorough understanding of rail\-airport integration, and the gravitas to lead complex, multi\-stakeholder programmes at the highest level.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Programme Leadership**
* Lead the multidisciplinary consultancy team across all project stages, ensuring delivery in line with the Client's programme management policies, the approved programme, budget, and quality requirements.
* Act as primary interface with the Client, relevant government authorities, and all project stakeholders; chair regular design workshops and charrettes as required by the contract.
* Establish and maintain the Programme Management Plan and all subsidiary management plans required under the Client's framework, with progressive updates throughout delivery.
* Mobilise and manage all project resources, including specialist sub\-consultants, ensuring adequate staffing at all stages.


**Technical Oversight**
* Direct multidisciplinary design integration across civil, structural, systems, MEP, architecture, and rail disciplines, ensuring compliance with the Client's Rail Project Design Guidelines.
* Oversee airport\-rail interface definition and coordination with airport stakeholders, including Mobility Hub, baggage handling, and security systems integration.
* Govern the project's BIM framework and Master Information Delivery Plan (MIDP) in line with PAS 1192, and oversee systems assurance, RAMS, hazard management, and V\&V activities.
* Lead tender preparation for the Design \& Construct contract and manage pre\-qualification, tender administration, evaluation, and award.
* Administer the D\&C contract, overseeing design review and approval, contractor submissions, cost and schedule management, and supervision through testing and commissioning.


**Stakeholder \& NOC Management**
* Manage all stakeholder interfaces and coordinate the timely obtaining of NOCs from relevant Dubai authorities and service agencies.
* Manage all project correspondence through Aconex and maintain weekly, biweekly, and monthly reporting to the Client in agreed formats.


**Commercial \& Risk Management**
* Monitor programme performance against baseline; manage risks, changes, and claims; drive value management and value engineering across all design stages.
* Oversee CAPEX/OPEX estimation, cost monitoring, and financial reporting in Client\-required formats.


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's degree in engineering or related technical discipline; Master's degree an advantage. Professional certification (ICE, PMP, APM or equivalent) is desirable.
* Minimum 20 years' experience, with at least 10 years managing large\-scale rail or metro infrastructure programmes at Project or Program Director level.
* Proven track record delivering major rail programmes — metro, commuter, or express rail — from feasibility through commissioning and close\-out.
* Experience managing D\&C contracts exceeding $1bn, and complex multi\-stakeholder environments involving government authorities, airport operators, and utility agencies.
* Knowledge of rail systems integration (signalling, rolling stock, traction power, AFC, PSD, communications), airport\-rail interface requirements, BIM/PAS 1192, systems assurance, and RAMS.
* Excellent English communication skills, Prior direct experience in the Middle East is a significant advantage.
* Professional certification or membership of a recognized institute is desirable.


**What Desired Skills You’ll Bring**
* Familiarity with FIDIC\-based consultancy agreements, IBM DOORS\-NG/ELM, and Aconex.
* Experience on airport express, airport connector, or inter\-terminal transit rail systems.
* Passenger flow modelling and peak demand analysis in airport or transit hub contexts.
* Knowledge of LEED certification, sustainability frameworks, and renewable energy integration in infrastructure projects.


 Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove**
 Moove is building the world’s largest fleet and best\-in\-class technologies that power mobility platforms. Its flagship Drive\-to\-Own (DTO) product democratises access to vehicle ownership with a revolutionary revenue based financing model, enabling underserved mobility entrepreneurs to thrive.
   

  

 Moove’s growth has been fuelled by its global Uber partnership and support of leading investors and lenders, including Uber, Mubadala, BlackRock, MUFG, and many others. With operations now spanning 19 cities across 6 continents \- Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, South America, and the Middle East \- Moove continues to expand its offerings through strategic acquisitions and partnerships with industry leaders, including Waymo and Uber. Moove is transforming mobility to make it safer, more efficient and accessible to all, while providing economic opportunities and supporting skills development in the mobility sector.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Director of Performance \& Strategy at Moove is responsible for driving business performance, planning discipline, and execution across markets. This role owns the end\-to\-end performance management cycle, including running business reviews, leading planning processes, and identifying and driving resolution of key performance issues in partnership with market and functional leaders. In parallel, you will act as a strategic partner to local teams, supporting critical decisions on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion, while aligning cross\-functional stakeholders. The role also leads key strategic initiatives, including new market launches, new business lines (e.g. AV), and other growth opportunities, ensuring disciplined execution from planning through implementation.
   

  

**This role is a "temp role" of 6 months.**
**What You’ll Be Doing**
 As Moove scales across markets, this role ensures consistent delivery across four core areas: business performance, project management across centrally driven initiatives, expansion, and cross\-functional execution.
   

  

 Critical outcomes (6–12 months)
   

  

* Establish a consistent performance management cadence across markets (SteerCos, dashboards, planning cycles)
* Identify and address key drivers of underperformance, improving profitability and operational efficiency
* Deliver high\-impact strategic initiatives (e.g., market launches, pricing improvements, new revenue streams)


 Scope of responsibilities \& impact areas
   

  

* Performance Management: Own weekly and monthly business reviews, track key metrics, and lead deep dives to understand performance drivers and gaps
* Strategic Planning: Lead annual budgeting, OKRs, and quarterly planning processes, ensuring alignment between company goals and market execution
* Market Support: Provide hands\-on support to local teams on growth, profitability, pricing, and expansion decisions through structured analysis
* Cross\-Functional Alignment: Work closely with Finance, Legal, Tech, and Operations to resolve issues and ensure delivery of key priorities
* Data \& Reporting: Partner with Data/BI teams to build and maintain accurate, automated dashboards, ensuring a single source of truth and reducing manual reporting
* Central Program Management: Track and manage key strategic commitments, ensuring accountability and timely execution across teams
* Expansion \& Growth: Support and lead new market launches, new categories, and other strategic initiatives from evaluation through implementation


**What You Will Need For This Position**
 Experience:
   

  

* 10\-12\+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, or similar roles in high\-growth environments
* Strong track record of driving business performance and solving complex operational problems
* Experience working across multiple markets or regions is preferred


 Education \& Skills:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related field Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and financial modeling
* Familiarity with BI tools
* Solid understanding of unit economics, cost structures, and performance drivers


 Behavioural \& Leadership Traits:
   

  

* Structured problem\-solver with strong attention to detail
* Ability to manage stakeholders and influence decisions across teams
* Clear and effective communicator, including with senior leadership
* High ownership and ability to operate in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments
* Focus on execution and delivering measurable outcomes


**Key Metrics**
**I** 
 mprovement in core business metrics such as revenue growth, utilization, contribution margin, and cashflow
   

  

* Effectiveness of performance management processes (e.g., quality and consistency of reviews, dashboard adoption)
* Successful delivery of strategic initiatives, including market launches and new revenue streams


**Who You'll Be Working with:**
 Directly reporting to our CEO Moove, and closely working with our Central OperationsTeam.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
   

  

 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.
   

  

**Pre\-hiring Notice:** 
 Moove relies on the accuracy of information contained in employment applications, as well as the accuracy of other data presented throughout the hiring process and during employment. Any misrepresentations, falsifications, or material omissions in any information or data provided by an applicant may result in the applicant being excluded from further consideration for employment or if an individual has already been hired, termination of employment.
   

  

**EEO Statement:** 
 Moove is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, race, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, political affiliation or any other protected characteristic.

**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services.  We are looking for an experienced
 **Director of Project Execution**

You will provide guidance and leadership to the Project Execution and Site Management teams, foster collaboration across internal functions and external stakeholders, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on\-time, on\-budget, contract compliant, and to the required quality through to handover.
   

  

**What are my responsibilities?**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of airport BHS/MHS programs, ensuring safe, on\-budget, contract\-compliant execution.
* Serve as senior client and stakeholder lead, aligning airport authorities/operators, consultants/PMCs, contractors, and internal teams.

* Drive strong project governance (steerco, reviews, workshops), ensuring clear decisions, actions, and follow\-up.

* Ensure completeness and quality of technical/contract documentation and reporting across the project lifecycle.
* Lead successful handovers to Life\-Cycle Services, ensuring continuity, training, spares, warranty transition, and sign\-off.

* Proven leadership in multi\-stakeholder environments with strong client\-facing and executive communication capability.
* Strong experience in airport BHS or MHS systems including site execution and commissioning; ORAT exposure is a plus.
* Solid understanding of automation integration environments (mechanical/electrical, PLC/SCADA/controls, interfaces).
* Strong commercial and contractual discipline: change control, risk/opportunity management, claims awareness.
* Proficient in project tools (e.g., MS Project/Primavera, MS Office; Jira/Confluence is a plus).
* Willingness to travel and operate in dynamic airport environments.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

**Job Overview
 
 :** 




 The Projects Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, governance, and successful delivery of all projects within the organization. The role oversees the full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through execution and handover, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The Projects Director operates as the senior authority across all project teams, aligning engineering, procurement, commercial, and site operations with the company’s business objectives and premium construction standards.

 :** 




 Strategic Leadership \& Portfolio Management
 


* Lead and oversee the entire project portfolio from inception to final handover.
* Define project governance structures, reporting frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
* Align project execution strategy with corporate financial and operational objectives.
* Review and approve master schedules, budgets, and procurement strategies.
* Establish project performance KPIs, including cost variance, schedule variance, productivity, and margin.



 Project Execution \& Operational Excellence
 


* Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations and company standards.
* Monitor progress across multiple projects and intervene proactively to resolve bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective coordination between engineering, procurement, commercial, and site teams.
* Drive continuous improvement in construction methodologies and resource utilization.
* Ensure strict adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality benchmarks.



 Financial \& Commercial Management
 


* Oversee project budgeting, forecasting, and cost control mechanisms.
* Review and approve major variations, subcontractor agreements, and commercial negotiations.
* Safeguard project profitability, cash flow, and margin performance.
* Monitor procurement efficiency and material cost optimization.
* Ensure proper contract administration and claims management practices.



 Risk, Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure compliance with UAE construction regulations, safety standards, and contractual requirements.
* Implement enterprise\-level risk mitigation strategies across all active projects.
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture with zero\-incident objectives.
* Ensure implementation of quality assurance and quality control systems across sites.



 Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and evaluate Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the executive representative for clients, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Ensure high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and resolution of concerns.
* Strengthen cross\-functional collaboration to ensure seamless project execution.
* Support succession planning and capability development within the project's function.



 Personal Attributes:
 


* Strong leadership qualities with the ability to manage a diverse team and maintain project momentum.
* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen.
* Results\-driven with a high accountability and ownership mindset.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented with a problem\-solving mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines while maintaining quality standards.
* High level of professionalism and discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Strong commitment to safety and quality on\-site.



  





**Requirements
 
 :** 



* A minimum of 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in construction project management, with a proven track record working with reputable contracting companies in the UAE.
* Proven experience in managing luxury projects,
 **including high\-end villas** 
 , with a strong understanding of premium construction standards and finishes.

**Qualification
 
 :** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field from a recognized university.
* Master’s Degree or professional certifications (PMP, RICS, etc.) preferred.

**INSPIRE \| EXHILARATE \| DELIGHT**
 For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East.  Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.
   

  

 Chalhoub Group fosters a people\-at\-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future\-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.
   

  

 Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040\.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The Transformation Program Governance Director provides strategic oversight and leadership across the Group’s multi\-year digital transformation program. This role ensures disciplined execution, strategic alignment, and value realization across all streams, while acting as the guardian of program governance, standards, and vendor accountability. Operating at Group level, this leader drives cross\-entity alignment, embeds best\-in\-class governance frameworks, and establishes the program as a benchmark for disciplined transformation delivery.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Lead executive governance for the entire digital transformation program, strategically allocating resources, budgets, and priorities to maximize business impact.
* Safeguard program outcomes by overseeing benefit realization and hold workstreams accountable for delivering measurable value and results.
* Support and challenge program leaders to ensure delivery excellence, proactively managing risks, dependencies, and barriers.
* Provide senior leadership with data\-driven insights, independent assurance, and strategic recommendations to guide decision\-making.
* Define, document and continuously evolve Group\-wide governance frameworks, standards, and policies to ensure consistent and mature program delivery.
* Establish and maintain a Transformation Governance Center of Excellence (CoE) offering tools, methodologies, and training for standardized delivery.
* Uphold governance rigor by designing and maintaining clear decision\-making structures, reporting mechanisms, and escalation protocols that ensure transparency and accountability at all levels.
* Act as a senior escalation point and manage strategic vendor relationships, ensuring partners meet contractual commitments, quality standards, and timely delivery.
* Shape vendor engagement models and collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to optimize commercial terms, risk management and cost control across all vendor engagements.
* Ensure alignment across Group entities and business units, so that transformation initiatives are integrated seamlessly into the operating model and enable scalable adoption.
* Drive transparent, timely reporting and foster collaboration across geographies and functions to maintain senior stakeholder engagement and informed executive committees and SteerCos, enabling informed decision\-making and program steering.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Proven experience in leading governance and execution for large\-scale, multi\-year digital transformation programs, ideally in a multi\-entity or international group context.
* Deep expertise in governance design, operating models, and transformation frameworks, with a track record of institutionalizing standards at Group level.
* Strong leadership and influencing skills, with the ability to engage at C\-suite and Board level.
* Demonstrated success in vendor and partner governance, including complex system integrator or technology engagements.
* Strategic thinker with operational discipline, able to balance control, flexibility, and delivery speed.
* Excellent communication, diplomacy, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultures and functions.


**What We Can Offer You**
 With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.
   

  

 We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.
   

  

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**
 To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.
   

  

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 This role is for someone who wants real ownership.
   

  

 You’ll be the right hand to the Network Health and Trust \& Safety leadership, owning complex, high\-impact programs that protect customers, partners, and the business. This is not a reporting or coordination role. You will identify risks before they escalate, turn ambiguity into clear execution plans, and drive programs that balance safety, compliance, and operational reality.
   

  

 You’ll work across teams that don’t naturally align, often without direct authority. Your job is to connect the dots, make hard calls, and ensure the right things get done on time, at scale, and with measurable impact.
   

  

 If you enjoy solving messy problems, influencing senior stakeholders, and building mechanisms that last, this role will stretch you in the best way.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end Trust \& Safety and Network Health programs from problem definition to execution and sustained outcomes
* Identify systemic risks and compliance gaps; design scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Drive execution across multiple teams with competing priorities
* Set clear goals, milestones, and success metrics for complex initiatives
* Act as a thought partner to senior leadership on risk, safety, and long\-term strategy
* Build simple, durable mechanisms to track progress and enforce standards
* Raise the bar on how programs are designed, reviewed, and communicated


 A day in the life
   

  

**On a Typical Day, You Might**
* Deep dive into data to understand where risks are emerging and why
* Align with product, operations, legal, and analytics partners on priorities and trade\-offs
* Challenge unclear plans and push for sharper problem statements and success metrics
* Review program progress, unblock teams, and escalate when needed
* Translate complex issues into clear updates for senior stakeholders
* Improve existing processes so teams spend less time reacting and more time preventing issues


 Your internal stakeholders include operations leaders, product teams, analytics partners, and legal or policy counterparts.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Network Health (NH) and Trust \& Safety (T\&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey).
   

  

 Network Health owns the end\-to\-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring \& Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations.
   

  

 Trust \& Safety complements this work by focusing on driver\-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as ID Check, APEA, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero\-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare.
   

  

 This role operates at the intersection of both functions, helping deliver secure, compliant, and sustainable operations in one of Amazon’s fastest\-growing regions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables \& charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field

 .

 Starting monthly salary at 8,000 AED per month

**It's more than a job**
 In an administrative role at Kuehne\+Nagel, tasks such as managing office operations or coordinating schedules certainly contribute to your team's success, but they also provide meaningful moments for people around the world. Because your attention to detail supports your colleagues to perform at their best, such as ensuring the timely and seamless transport of hearing aids and advanced medical devices that change lives. At Kuehne\+Nagel, our work contributes to more than we imagine.
   

  

 ‎
   

  

 Energy Business Development Manager role is one of the most critical commercial positions supporting our Project Logistics strategy. The EBDM reports directly to the Global Head of Project Logistics Energy.No team reports into this position; it is an individual contributor role with significant strategic impact.
   

  

 The EBDM is responsible for generating new business opportunities across all segments of the Oil \& Gas value chain, developing a strong pipeline within defined markets, and analysing market potential and competitive dynamics to prioritize opportunities aligned with strategic goals.
   

  

 Working closely with global and regional stakeholders, the Energy Business Development Manager builds customer relationships based on trust, expertise, and innovation, ensuring the right internal and external partners are engaged at the right time to secure new projects.
   

  

 This role requires a professional who exemplifies strong Compliance and HSE standards, demonstrates strategic thinking, and thrives in a customer‑centric, high‑impact environment.
   

  

**How you create impact**
* Identify new business opportunities and coordinate cross‑functional teams to develop these into firm project awards.
* Lead and manage global tenders and bids for major potential customers, securing required approvals from relevant stakeholders, including the IPMT.
* Monitor the business pipeline and success ratios, taking corrective actions together with the Global Head of Project Logistics Business Development when needed.
* Maintain regular communication with key internal stakeholders (Global/National Project Logistics Teams, Tender Management, etc.) and provide updates to senior leadership upon request.
* Demonstrate self\-driven, motivational leadership by communicating clear goals, securing stakeholder buy‑in, and aligning activities with strategic direction.
* Record all opportunities in Corelog and act as a role model for Compliance and HSE standards.
* Foster strong collaboration across Project Logistics Development functions, Operations, Technology, and both Geographic and Technical Leadership teams.
* Drive Gross Profit growth by identifying and securing profitable business opportunities aligned with the Project Logistics Roadmap and strategic objectives.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders, develop business and account plans, and pursue opportunities in alignment with (Key) Account Owners or independently where appropriate.


**What we would like you to bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field; Master’s degree preferred.
* Proven experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Commercial roles within Energy, Oil \& Gas, EPC, or Project Logistics.
* Strong understanding of the Oil \& Gas value chain and major project cycles, including tendering and contract negotiation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex global bids and manage senior‑level customer engagements.
* Strong analytical and strategic planning skills, with the ability to assess markets, build business plans, and prioritize opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills across global and matrixed organizations.
* High level of self‑motivation and ownership, with a strong commitment to Compliance and HSE standards; proficiency in CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.


**What's in it for you**
 In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact within Kuehne\+Nagel by shaping major Energy and Project Logistics developments, working in an international and collaborative environment, gaining visibility with global leadership, and benefiting from a culture that values ownership, innovation, and professional growth.
   

  

**Who are we**
 Logistics shapes everyday life \- from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne\+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
   

  

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life\-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
   

  

 We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

**Description**
**Zutari: Co\-creating an engineered impact.**
 Zutari is a well\-established, management\-owned engineering firm with almost 90 years' experience. As human\-centred engineering consultants and advisors, we are trusted by our clients, business partners, communities and other stakeholders across Africa.
   

  

 We co\-create engineering solutions that have a positive impact and improve people's lives. Zutari values inclusion and recognises the importance of a diverse, talented workforce, believing that people need other people to succeed.
   

  

**What kind of talent do we pursue?**
 We employ people with the right attitude and a positive mindset, who are motivated by doing the right thing, getting things done and share a sense of urgency. People who have an impact in our teams and broader community. People who think differently and connect with those around them to co\-create new opportunities and leave a meaningful legacy.
   

  

**About the role:**
 As
 **Operations Director: Built Environment** 
 for
 **Zutari MENA** 
 , based in
 **Dubai** 
 , you will play a critical role in driving the operational success, delivery excellence, and commercial performance of Zutari’s Build Environment portfolio across the Middle East and North Africa.
   

  

 This role is responsible for operationalising sector strategy, leading day\-to\-day business operations, enabling consistent high\-quality project delivery, and strengthening collaboration across technical, commercial, and support teams. The incumbent will ensure that Zutari’s Built Environment operations are positioned for sustainable growth, market relevance, and exceptional client outcomes across sectors such as commercial, mixed\-use, hospitality, healthcare, education, leisure and entertainment, aviation, and public infrastructure. The role entails strong Zutari inter\-departmental relationships and a We Are One mindset.
   

  

 This is a senior leadership role requiring strong operational discipline, strategic insight, sound commercial judgment, and the ability to build trusted relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will also establish operational goals, performance metrics, and KPIs to monitor business unit health, project performance, and delivery effectiveness.
   

  

 The incumbent will be expected to travel across the
 **MENA region** 
 as required to support clients, projects, and partner engagement
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy formulation and operational implementation**
* Contribute to the development and refinement of the Built Environment strategy for Zutari MENA, aligned to the broader regional and group business objectives.
* Translate strategy into operational priorities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes across the business unit.
* Monitor implementation of strategic initiatives and intervene where required to improve execution.
* Provide market and project delivery insights to identify growth opportunities, strengthen competitiveness, and respond to evolving client needs.
* Support market penetration in priority MENA geographies through operational readiness, delivery capability, and partner alignment.
* Grow Zutaris’ service offerings in the region to align with client and market expectations, as well as overall MENA and Group strategies.
* Drive digitally focused solutions through the team to ensure efficiency, market relevance and increased quality in delivery.


**Service delivery and risk mitigation**
* Support the development of strong client and stakeholder relationships to understand needs and deliver tailored Built Environment solutions.
* Review project technical and commercial delivery approaches, including risk elements, prior to contract award to minimise downstream delivery risk.
* Ensure projects are set up in line with Zutari’s delivery requirements, including digital delivery, knowledge management, resourcing, health and safety, quality, and environmental compliance.
* Appoint and support appropriate Project Executives, Design Leads, and Opportunity Managers to lead opportunities and projects from inception to close\-out.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects across the Built Environment portfolio in line with quality, programme, commercial, and client expectations.
* Monitor project performance proactively to identify delivery, commercial, contractual, technical, or reputational risks and ensure timely mitigation.
* Escalate material risks to the appropriate governance and leadership levels.
* Oversee delivery assurance across key disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, public health, fire engineering, specialist systems, structural, geotech, facades and sustainability integration.


**Resource management**
* Optimise the deployment of business unit and wider Zutari resources to align with current and future project demands.
* Ensure effective resourcing decisions across priorities, skills, capacity, and budget constraints.
* Build operational capability by supporting recruitment, succession planning, and technical development within the Built Environment team.
* Ensure staff are equipped with the training, tools, and support required to deliver high\-quality work in a fast\-paced MENA environment.
* Foster multidisciplinary collaboration across all internal disciplines and external project and client teams.


**Operational management**
* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of the Built Environment business, including project delivery oversight, utilisation, workforce planning, quality management, and budget performance.
* Establish, track, and report on KPIs to drive operational excellence and accountability.
* Provide guidance on opportunity management, bid structuring, delivery models, and partner engagement.
* Implement and uphold technical standards, project governance requirements, and compliance procedures across the business unit.
* Drive consistency in delivery methodologies, design management, and project controls.
* Strengthen operational maturity in relation to design coordination, authority approvals, and complex stakeholder environments typical of the UAE, KSA and wider MENA market.


**Sales and financial performance**
* Support the achievement of sales, revenue, margin, and cash performance targets for the Built Environment business.
* Monitor business and project financial performance, analyse variances, and implement corrective actions where required.
* Support and review scope changes, variation orders, claims positions, and commercial negotiations in conjunction with project leaders.
* Contribute to pipeline conversion by ensuring robust delivery planning, partner strategies, and resourcing confidence at bid stage.
* Help strengthen Zutari’s market position with developers, architects, contractors, public sector entities, asset owners, and regional delivery partners.


**Optimise operations**
* Implement measures that improve value creation, operational efficiency, and profitability across the Built Environment portfolio.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and streamline operational workflows to enhance productivity and delivery consistency.
* Drive lessons learnt, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing across projects and teams.
* Support digitisation and innovation initiatives that improve coordination, reporting, and project outcomes.


**Collaboration and co\-ordination**
* Ensure effective communication and collaboration across business units, sectors, and regional support functions.
* Coordinate seamless integration of multidisciplinary solutions and client offerings.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, key clients, contractors, developers, and relevant industry bodies in the MENA market.
* Work closely with regional leadership to align operational priorities with client strategy, growth plans, and delivery capacity.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Professionally registered engineer or eligible for professional registration with a recognised body
* PMP or equivalent project/programme management certification will be advantageous.
* MBA or similar postgraduate business qualification will be advantageous.


**Other Requirements**
* At least 10 years’ proven experience in an operations, project delivery, or business leadership role of a similar nature.
* Demonstrated at least 10 Years experience in Built Environment consulting within the Middle East.
* Strong understanding of the Built Environment market, including multidiscipline engineering services delivery in an LDC scenario.
* Proven experience working with private developers, architects, contractors, government entities, and major institutional clients in the UAE, KSA and wider MENA region.
* Established professional network in the MENA built environment sector.
* Strong experience in leading LDC and multidiscipline large scale project bids.
* Proven leadership and management experience in a professional services environment, with a strong focus on operational efficiency and delivery excellence.
* Strong understanding of client relationship management, client service, and key account development.
* Strong commercial acumen, including project finance, contract risk, variation management, and margin control.
* Proven ability to identify, assess, and manage operational and delivery risk proactively.
* Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire, guide, and motivate multidisciplinary teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to use data and operational metrics to support strategic decision\-making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic would be advantageous.
* Ability to adapt to changing client needs, market dynamics, and delivery environments across MENA.


***We believe that a diverse workforce is key to our business success. We seek the best people for our jobs based on their skills, qualifications, and experience. We embrace the principle of equal opportunity in employment, and we work towards eliminating all forms of unlawful discrimination in our employ.***

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon Now is building the future of ultra\-fast grocery delivery across the Middle East. We are looking for a Program Manager to drive measurable improvements across store capacity management, cost\-per\-order reduction, and delivery speed (Click\-to\-Door).
   

  

 This role sits within the Operations Excellence function and is responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering high\-impact programmes that improve customer experience and unit economics across Amazon Now’s network in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 You will work across Last Mile, Middle Mile, and Under\-The\-Roof (UTR) operations to find inefficiencies, build the business case, and drive cross\-functional execution. This is not a reactive role, you will proactively identify opportunities before they become problems, connect the dots across operational channels, and ensure every initiative ladders up to CX outcomes and P\&L impact.
   

  

 The right candidate is analytically sharp, comfortable with ambiguity, and operates with a bias for action. You think in systems, not silos. You’re as comfortable in the data as you are in a room with senior stakeholders making the case for change.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Store Capacity \& Cost Management
   

  

* Own programmes to optimise store capacity utilization, including bin density, ASIN rationalisation, gas tank management, and space allocation across darkstores.
* Drive cost\-per\-order reduction across the end\-to\-end operation: UTR pick efficiency, DA (Delivery Associate) productivity, hub\-to\-store transhipment costs, and middle mile truck utilisation.
* Analyse operational cost structures to identify the highest\-leverage opportunities for unit economics improvement. Build business cases with clear ROI and execution plans.
* Partner with UTR, Last Mile, and Middle Mile teams to implement changes that reduce waste, improve throughput, and lower cost\-to\-serve without degrading customer experience.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track capacity utilisation and cost metrics across KSA stores.


 Delivery Speed \& Click\-to\-Door (C2D)
   

  

* Own the programme roadmap for C2D reduction, identifying bottlenecks across order acceptance, pick \& pack, dispatch, and last mile delivery.
* Analyse delivery defects, early delivery marking, Did\-Not\-Receive (DNR) patterns, and other CX pain points to drive root cause resolution.
* Identify and eliminate handoff delays between UTR, Middle Mile, and Last Mile that contribute to C2D inflation.


 Project \& Programme Delivery
   

  

* Scope, plan, and execute operational improvement projects end\-to\-end, from opportunity identification through to measurable business impact.
* Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives across capacity, cost, and speed, with clear prioritisation based on CX and P\&L impact.
* Create mechanisms for project tracking, stakeholder communication, and escalation. Maintain a clear view of project status, risks, and dependencies.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment with ACES, Tech, Finance, Category, and operations teams to remove blockers and deliver on commitments.
* Contribute to the development of scalable solutions that can be replicated across KSA stores, solve once, scale everywhere.


 Cross\-Functional Influence \& Visibility
   

  

* Operate as the connective tissue between operational channels, ensuring improvements in one area don’t create problems in another.
* Build visibility into operational performance through data, dashboards, and regular reporting cadences (WBR/MBR contributions).
* Influence without authority, drive outcomes through data\-backed recommendations, clear communication, and stakeholder management.
* Support Automation \& AI initiatives that drive efficiency, reduce manual effort, and improve decision\-making across operations.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 5\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Master's degree
* Experience in program requirements definition, together with data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 5\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

**Job Description**
**Do you relish the prospect of providing end to end support across multiple product suites such as Cloud, AI and Cybersecurity?**
**Would you like the opportunity to work in a high\-impact role responsible for building customer loyalty around the Middle East?**
**Join our prestigious Professional Services team**
 Our Team provides managed services and proactive and reactive support to our global customers. We utilize tools, process and knowledge to integrate and maintain Akamai security, media, and performance solutions for our clients. We collaborate to solve problems, innovate to provide creative solutions and work to improve for our customers and team.
   

  

**Become a trusted advisor**
 As a Technical Project Manager, from pre\-sales through to integration and performance, you will be an end\-to\-end trusted advisor to customers, managing their engagement with our platform and building technical solutions. In a high\-impact environment you'll be project managing, problem\-solving and building close relationships with customers across many industries.
   

  

 As a Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Advocating best practices for the customer and internal teams during product implementation, and providing customer feedback to the Product team
* Being the central point of contact for customers and leading the integrated account team delivering customer success
* Partnering with the business to review and ensure integration efficiency, high quality service and keep customers engaged
* Identifying service enhancements and potential problems to ensure continuous improvements to quality of customer service delivery
* Communicating with internal, external customers and partners to share information and deliverables


**Do What You Love**
 To be successful in this role you will:
   

  

* Demonstrate experience in a customer\-facing role within the information technology industry
* Show some experience of managing and delivering technical customer projects successfully
* Show understanding of network, web performance, and application/network security technologies/architectures as well as project management methodologies
* Demonstrate experience in managing multiple priorities
* Demonstrate communication skills and an ability to build trusting relationships with customers across various levels
* Be fluent in Arabic and English


**About Us**
 At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
   

  

 Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
   

  

**Our Focus Is Simple**
**Cloud and Edge:** 
 Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
   

  

**Security** 
 : Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
   

  

**Content Delivery** 
 : Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
   

  

**AI** 
 : Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
   

  

 At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
   

  

**Benefits at Akamai:** 
 We support your health, well\-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
   

  

**FlexBase adapts to your job's needs**
 Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
   

  

 We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
   

  

 Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 As a PM on the Supply Chain Automation team, you'll design and build full\-stack applications and data\-intensive systems that power critical supply chain decisions. You'll work with massive datasets, develop and implement science\-based artifacts capable to impact broader supply chain, and create intuitive interfaces that enable our operations teams to work smarter and faster.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Design, develop, and deploy full\-stack applications for supply chain optimization and automation
   

  

 Build scalable backend services using modern technologies (Java, Python, Node.js, etc.) on AWS infrastructure
   

  

 Develop responsive, performant frontend applications using React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Redux, and modern web technologies
   

  

 Architect and implement data pipelines leveraging our lakehouse architecture with Apache Iceberg
   

  

 Work with large\-scale data systems including Amazon Redshift, S3, and EMR
   

  

 Perform data mining and analysis to uncover insights that drive supply chain improvements
   

  

 Develop and support scientific solutions that are exemplary in terms of design, clarity, extensibility, and the ability to evolve over time
   

  

 Innovate with the latest technology to build highly automated solutions for efficient forecasting and supply chain automation
   

  

 Design, develop and deploy end\-to\-end machine learning solutions in the Amazon production environment to improvise the current supply chain through forecasting
   

  

 Own the full software development lifecycle from design to deployment and operations
   

  

 Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and contribute to technical strategy
   

  

**About The Team**
 Join Amazon's Supply Chain Automation team, chartered with building the next generation of automation and optimization systems from the ground up. Our mission is to transform supply chain operations through intelligent automation, reducing manual effort while increasing speed, accuracy, and efficiency across Amazon's fulfillment network.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 2\+ years of software development experience
* 3\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science or equivalent
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust
* Experience designing rich user interfaces using modern web frameworks (such as React, Angular, and Vue)
* Knowledge of object\-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit\-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc.
* Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
* Experience effectively gathering information from multiple data sources
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project
data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of your Day**
 As a Project Procurement Manager you represent Supply Chain in the Project/Proposal Management Team and acts as the Sub\-project Manager leading the Project SCM strategy for Compressor packages. You will integrate procurement in the project management process and project teams and be involved during the sales phase. You will organize all procurement activities in a project under optimum deployment of resources. You also implement procurement strategies aiming to optimize project results, including availability of goods and services in quality, in time, in budget while ensuring observance of obligatory Procurement processes and regulations.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Early Involvement during sales phase: Analyze sales and operations planning in respect of starting/new projects in order to ensure the involvement of Procurement. Participate in project/sales meetings as project core team member to provide information about supply market, preferred suppliers and supplier innovation (regarding goods and services) at an early stage to optimize supplier strategy and selection of Major CTO and ETO equipment, such as Motors, Gears, Gas Engines, Acoustics equipment, Auxiliaries (Lube Systems, Gas Seal panels, etc); diversified components (Dry Gas Seals, Anti\-Surge Valves, other); extended scope such as WHRU, HRSG, Balance of Plant.
* Project Procurement standards: Establish proper sourcing processes, control all Procurement resources and activities in the project and inform all involved within Procurement to deliver optimum impact for the business (Procurement plan, target\-costing) relating to budget, availability, timeline and quality. Apply Procurement regulations as per Compliance, organization standards and PM@Siemens Energy
* Analysis: Analyze scope of supply, contractual obligations and exactly understand customer’s functional needs.Identify Procurement risks, opportunities, potential changes, claims and market forces during the entire project, together with Commodity Management, to avoid potential damage / exploit potential.
* Strategy definition and implementation: Derive Procurement strategy for assigned projects in accordance with Business Unit \& Operating Company Procurement strategies and ensure implementation. Introduce negotiation recommendations together with Commodity Management to prepare for negotiations with suppliers (back\-to\-back where appropriate) and to initiate appropriate measures.
* Negotiation: Lead complex contractual and price, cash flow and commercial T\&C negotiations and/or support the specialist buyers responsible for particular material fields (in particular those not covered by any Commodity Management) to secure project targets with optimum conditions on the basis of ToCO.
* Contract Management: Ensure that major Procurement risks, changes to original scope of supply and potential claims (towards customers and suppliers) are covered in valid contracts. Ensure that contractual obligations (towards the customer that must be fulfilled by supplier) are covered in a way that mitigates the own risk exposure.
* Supplier Management / Preferred Supplier List: Apply preferred supplier list (e.g. FPL), provide supplier information to the project team, coordinate Supplier Management in preparation for transition to Project execution phase (including Supplier Qualification, project\-specific supplier evaluations and supplier development).
* Knowledge management and documentation: Be proactive and forward systematically all relevant Procurement related project information (e.g. updated contractual conditions, Supplier Management data) to keep all project participants and relevant cross\-functional partners up to date. Share best practice and conduct lessons learn sessions. Sensitize cross\-functional partners for Procurement related practices processes and metrics.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) in an engineering discipline with minimum 5 years of relevant experience; or M.S. degree in engineering discipline with 3 years of relevant experience; or M.B.A with technical B.S. degree with 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent education and experience.
* Compression and/or Gas Turbine major equipment relevant technical proficiency preferred
* 5 Years experience minimum combined in related SCM functions, Project Procurement, Proposal and/or Project Management within Oil and Gas or Power Generation industry.
* Advanced MS Office applications skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint
* Advanced knowledge of sourcing process
* Advanced negotiation skills
* Good problem solving skills
* Cost Modeling
* Ability to work in a matrix organization
* Advanced data analytics
* Leader, self\-manage
* Ability to run presentations to management level
* Availability to travel estimated 15% of time


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 We are looking for a motivated
 **Graduate Project Manager \- Emirati National** 
 with an academic background in Architecture, Engineering, or Project Management to join our Integrated Design Leadership team within the Property \& Buildings division. This role provides the opportunity to support the delivery of innovative, sustainable, and multidisciplinary design projects from concept through construction.
   

  

 You will work alongside experienced project leaders, gaining exposure to high\-profile projects and developing strong project coordination and delivery skills in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Project Coordination \& Delivery**
* Assist in the planning, organisation, and coordination of large, multidisciplinary design projects.
* Support the tracking of project scope, deliverables, and contractual requirements to ensure accurate execution.
* Assist in preparing project schedules, action logs, and resource plans.
* Help ensure project workflows align with overall programme milestones.


**Team \& Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Coordinate day\-to\-day interactions with engineering and architectural disciplines.
* Facilitate communication by sharing updates, priorities, and actions with internal project teams.
* Support project leads in client and stakeholder communication.
* Assist with coordination between internal teams and relevant authorities to ensure alignment and secure required approvals.


**Quality \& Compliance**
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure quality standards and project requirements are met.
* Help monitor project risks, issues, and progress and report updates to the Project Manager.


**Meetings \& Documentation**
* Participate in internal and external project meetings, contributing to collaborative problem‑solving and decision‑making.
* Assist in preparing project reports, meeting minutes, presentations, and documentation.


**Business Support \& Innovation**
* Support the delivery of the Business Unit (BU) strategy, including sustainability and innovation initiatives.
* Identify potential business development or client engagement opportunities and share them with the team.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in architecture, engineering, and project management.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, Project Management, or a related field.
* Understanding of integrated design and multidisciplinary project delivery processes.
* Familiarity with design tools and project management software (e.g., Revit, AutoCAD, MS Project).
* Strong organisational and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage tasks effectively, prioritise work, and adapt in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated commitment to quality, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
* Proactive, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a collaborative team setting.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Responsible for directing Professional and Continuing Education (PaCE) activities, including strategic planning, development, and execution of PaCE programmes, business development, training catalog oversight, and stakeholder engagement, to ensure alignment with market demand, client expectations, and the University’s policies and procedures.
   

  

 The Responsibilities
   

  

 Strategic \& Financial
   

  

* Lead the development and monitor the execution of the Department's strategy and align with ZU's strategic objectives, ensuring effective and efficient achievement of departmental operations.
* Oversee the Department’s performance through defined KPIs and targets, and continuously identify and recommend improvements to support the realisation of ZU's strategy.
* Direct the allocation of budget across the Department and ensure full adherence to approved plans and rectify any deviations in a timely manner.
* Provide the relevant organisational unit with consolidated budget input as required, ensuring that the Department’s requirements are appropriately addressed in the overall budget planning process.


 Operational
   

  

* Lead the development and execution of business development strategies to expand B2B and B2C professional training services in line with University’s objectives.
* Lead the establishment of strategic partnerships with industry, government, and community stakeholders to generate revenue, expand reach, and ensure programme sustainability.
* Lead the development of tailored proposals and promotional strategies to position PaCE as a leading provider.
* Direct the development, planning, and internal coordination of full\-scale and customised training programmes to ensure strategic alignment, resource optimisation, and successful delivery of the same.
* Lead the development and delivery of professional education programmes, including short courses, certifications, and hybrid learning models, to meet evolving market demands.
* Lead the engagement with external subject\-matter experts to maintain high\-quality content development and delivery across all training programmes.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised training catalog and digital infrastructure, including LMS platforms, to ensure seamless access to current and upcoming training offerings.
* Direct institutional compliance by ensuring documentation, reporting, and quality assurance mechanisms across all PaCE training activities.
* Direct institutional initiatives that promote faculty and student participation in entrepreneurial training, venture creation, and business incubation programmes offered by the PaCE department.
* Perform ad\-hoc activities related to the job duties, as requested by the direct supervisor.


 People Management
   

  

* Review consolidated workforce planning reports, talent acquisition strategies, and budgets at the Department level to ensure adequate staffing for optimal operational smoothness, and submit to the appropriate authority for final approval.
* Set performance management objectives for all reportees and perform mid\-year and year\-end performance reviews.
* Identify talent for pivotal roles from a succession management standpoint to ensure business continuity.
* Provide guidance to reporting managers on people management matters.
* Manage organisational units within the Department and ensure effective leadership to adequately manage human capital.


 The Requirements
   

  

* Master's Degree with a minimum of 15 years of experience and at least 10 years in a managerial position.
* Certification in a relevant field is preferred.


 The Benefits
   

  

 The University’s benefits package is highly attractive, with competitive tax\-free salaries in the U.A.E., cash housing, annual vacation airline tickets for the employee and immediate family, educational subsidies for children, and healthcare for the employee and sponsored family members.
   

  

 To Apply
   

  

 In addition to completing the online application form, attach a cover letter, a current CV, and the names and contact details of three professional references.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications, you will be contacted only if selected for an interview.
   

  

 For any further inquiries, please contact Recruitment@zu.ac.ae
