data.jd_text:
Technical Installation Project Manager
 



  





**Location:** 
 Dubai
 



**Industry:** 
 Luxury Aluminium Systems / Windows \& Doors / Architectural Glazing
 



  





 Position Overview
 



 My client is seeking a Technical Installation Project Manager to oversee the delivery and installation of high\-end aluminium window, sliding door, and glazing systems across luxury residential and commercial projects in the UAE.
 



  





 The role will manage site execution from pre\-installation coordination through to final handover, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, to specification, and to premium quality standards expected within the luxury villa and architectural glazing market.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will have strong technical knowledge of aluminium systems, façade/glazing installation, and experience managing installation teams on high\-end construction projects in the GCC.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Manage full installation lifecycle of aluminium windows, doors, curtain wall, and glazing systems.
* Coordinate with consultants, architects, contractors, suppliers, and internal production teams.
* Lead site installation teams and subcontractors across multiple projects.
* Ensure compliance with project drawings, specifications, and QA/QC standards.
* Conduct site surveys, installation planning, and technical coordination meetings.
* Monitor installation progress, productivity, and programme milestones.
* Resolve technical and site\-related issues during execution.
* Ensure HSE compliance across all project sites.
* Oversee snagging, testing, commissioning, and project handover processes.
* Prepare progress reports for senior management and clients.
* Support procurement and logistics coordination for project materials and installation schedules.



  





 Candidate Requirements
 


* Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* 5–10\+ years’ experience in:
* aluminium systems
* façade installation
* glazing projects
* premium windows \& doors
* Strong experience delivering luxury villa or high\-end residential projects in the UAE/GCC.
* Technical understanding of:
* slimline aluminium systems
* curtain wall systems
* glazing details
* façade interfaces
* waterproofing and installation tolerances
* Strong site management and client\-facing communication skills.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and shop drawings.
* Experience managing multicultural installation teams.
* UAE driving licence preferred.



  





 Preferred Profile
 


* European, British, or South African project delivery background preferred.
* Experience working with luxury developers, architects, and private clients.
* Strong understanding of premium finishing standards and bespoke installation requirements.



  





 Reporting To Operations Director / General Manager
 



  





 Package
 


* Competitive salary
* Company vehicle allowance
* Medical insurance
* Annual flight allowance
* Performance bonus structure
* Long\-term growth opportunity within a premium expanding brand in the UAE market

 The Executive Talent Acquisition team at Visa plays a strategic role in shaping the company’s leadership pipeline and driving its long\-term vision. This team manages full\-cycle executive recruitment globally, from sourcing and market mapping to candidate assessment and onboarding, ensuring Visa hires the right leaders to support Visa’s growth.

* Partners with internal teams including Workforce Planning, ETA Research, Coordination, Preboarding, Total Rewards and Talent Management to deliver a seamless end\-to\-end hiring experience.
* Leverages advanced data analytics and reporting (ATS, Excel, Talent Insights tools) to assess performance, identify trends and inform decision\-making.

By connecting regional needs to the global Executive TA framework, the role ensures consistency, governance and innovation in how Visa builds leadership capability across one of its most strategically important growth regions.
   

  

 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

* 12\+ years of experience in Executive Talent Acquisition or executive search in complex, multinational environments.
* Proven track record delivering senior executive hires across any markets in the CEMEA region, ideally within financial services, payments, technology or global matrixed organisations.
* Deep understanding of CEMEA talent markets, cultural nuances and cross\-border hiring considerations.
* Passion for inclusive hiring, data\-driven decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems.
* Highly advanced reporting and data analytics experience to identify hiring challenges and gaps.
* Ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, influencing senior stakeholders while driving execution excellence.
* Results\-oriented, self\-motivated, organised and resourceful.
* Detail\-oriented with a proven track record of juggling multiple tasks and meeting various deadlines.

data.jd_text:
The School Of Business Administration At The American University Of Sharjah Is Looking For a Head Of Department (HoD) For Economics And a Head Of Department For Finance Starting Fall 2026\. The Responsibility And Accountability Of An HoD Are Described Below
   

  

 The Head of Department (HoD) coordinates the academic and administrative functions of the department. As the elected representative of the faculty, the HoD is entrusted with advancing the department’s best interests by fostering collective faculty decision\-making, ensuring transparency in governance, safeguarding curriculum quality, supporting faculty development, and effectively representing departmental perspectives within the college and the wider university.
   

  

 The Head of Department represents and ensures the well\-being of the department faculty, and promotes an environment that supports faculty members and students in their efforts to succeed. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Head of Department engages in collaborative leadership with the faculty according to the AUS shared governance model of academic administration.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Academic Leadership
* Coordinates departmental curricula, scheduling and service assignments with faculty input, while overseeing curricular development, assessment and accreditation to ensure program quality and compliance.
* Holds accountability for programs, processes, data collection and reporting at the departmental level.
* Serves as an advocate of the department within the college/school and align broader university and college/school interests with departmental initiatives and activities.
* Promotes departmental programs internally and externally
* Faculty and Staff Development
* Mentors, evaluates and supports the professional development of faculty and staff, including structured faculty evaluations, annual staff evaluations and participation in faculty hiring.
* Encourages and facilitates the instructional and scholarly development of faculty
* Develops teaching schedules and service assignments, with consideration given to interests solicited from the faculty
* Student Experience
* Enhances the academic experience and addresses student concerns fairly and effectively.
* Governance and Compliance
* Reports to and be accountable to the Dean for departmental operations; represents departmental perspectives within college/school governance; fosters an environment of shared purpose, transparency and academic excellence; and ensures compliance with university policies and procedures.
* Resource and Program Management
* Manages departmental resources and budgets responsibly and transparently, in consultation with faculty, and promotes departmental programs internally and externally.
* Leads program accreditation efforts in the department
* Contributes to the assessment of and implementation of curricular changes


 Submissions of the CV and cover letter including prior relevant experience by those interested in the position are due on
 **Saturday, May 9th @ 5 pm.** 
 at
 **deanofsba@aus.edu**
**ABOUT THE SCHOOL:** 
 The School of Business Administration enrolls over 1,900 undergraduate and graduate students. QS World University Subject Rankings 2025 has named AUS number two (tied) in the UAE and among the top 300 universities globally for business and management studies, number one in the UAE (tied) and among the top 250 universities globally for accounting and finance, and number one (tied) in the UAE and top 400 universities globally in the category of economics and econometrics. The AUS MBA program is ranked second in the UAE, seventh (tied) in the Middle East and Africa region, and among the world's top 200 in the
 **QS Global MBA Rankings (2026\).** 
 The school offers a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration degree with majors in accounting, economics, finance, information systems and business analytics, management, marketing and supply chain management, as well as a Bachelor of Arts in Economics. Graduate degrees include the Master of Business Administration, Master of Business Data Analytics, Master of Science in Accounting, Master of Science in Economics and Policy, Master of Science in Finance, PhD in Finance and PhD in Management. The school has been accredited by the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) since April 2011\.
   

  

**ABOUT THE UNIVERSITY:** 
 American University of Sharjah (AUS) is a comprehensive, independent, non\-profit, coeducational institution of higher education that promotes excellence in teaching, learning, research and creative work. AUS fosters a community that celebrates diversity and whose members are committed to the ideals of open intellectual inquiry, ethical behavior and civic responsibility. Its rank among the top five universities with the highest percentage of international students (Times Higher Education, 2024\) is a testament to that ideal. AUS is licensed and its degree programs are
 **accredited** 
 by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the UAE Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.. Additionally, AUS has been accredited in the USA by the
 **Middle States Commission on Higher Education** 
 since June 2004\. In addition to the School of Business Administration, the university includes the College of Engineering, the College of Arts and Sciences, and the College of Architecture, Art and Design, serving more than 6,000 students from approximately 100 nationalities. The university curricula, teaching standards and employment norms are fully in tune with the American model of higher education.
   

  

 The AUS campus is located at the heart of Sharjah’s University City, adjacent to the Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park and Sharjah International Airport, only 35 minutes away from Downtown Dubai and 20 minutes away from Dubai International Airport. For more information, please visit
 **www.aus.edu** 
 .
   

  

**ABOUT SHARJAH AND THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES:** 
 UAE is home to more than 10 million people from over 200 nationalities. Sharjah is the third most populous of the UAE’s seven emirates after Dubai and Abu Dhabi. For more information, see
 **https://u.ae/en/about\-the\-uae** 
 . Sharjah is widely regarded as a center of culture and education and serves as home to an industrious and dynamic population. Like the UAE, Sharjah provides a safe and comfortable environment that offers easy access to the UAE’s many beaches, the Hajar Mountains and a multitude of leisure establishments, all within a short driving distance. Given the country’s location and robust transportation infrastructure, travel to Asia, Africa and Europe is easy. These are advantages that are easily accessible given that Sharjah takes facilitating work\-life balance seriously as is evidenced by it having instituted a four\-day workweek.

 At 2 Hour Learning, we've designed a system in which students achieve twice the learning velocity in just two hours daily. AI\-driven tutoring, mastery\-oriented progression, and a fundamental break from traditional classroom formats underpin these results. The outcomes are remarkable. We now need a leader who can harmonize execution across varied school models, elevate academic leadership standards, and serve as the public advocate for a movement rooted in disciplined learning science.
   

  

 This is not a role focused on academic theory. It's a leadership imperative. You'll own the academic strategy in execution, establish rigorous standards, surface gaps in delivery, and mentor high\-performing teams to achieve tangible results. **What You Won’t Be Doing**
* Working on isolated curriculum initiatives without generating systemic impact.
* Producing theoretical research disconnected from student outcomes or operational execution.
* Handing off performance accountability to middle management or external consultants.
* Depending on institutional reputation or abstract theory to convince critical stakeholders.


**Director Of Academic Excellence Key Responsibilities**
 Expand and elevate 2 Hour Learning's validated academic model by harmonizing execution across school sites, raising leadership standards, and serving as the authoritative public voice of a movement anchored in rigorous science and demonstrated results.
   

  

**Basic Requirements**

**About 2 Hour Learning**
 Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one\-size\-fits\-all model and replacing it with AI\-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.

**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**

**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.

data.jd_text:
**About Moove** 




 Moove is a global mobility fintech and operations company focused on transforming mobility through innovative fleet solutions, mobility, and next\-generation transportation technologies. As we expand our operations across the UAE and GCC region, we are looking for an experienced and highly driven Project Manager to support the launch and scaling of new mobility and automotive projects.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role leads the planning, coordination, and execution of new mobility and automotive projects across the UAE. Working closely with internal teams, OEM partners, technology providers, and strategic stakeholders, the Program Manager drives initiatives from concept through commercial launch ensuring Moove’s expansion is delivered on time, at scale, and to the highest operational standard.
 



 The role requires strong project management expertise, stakeholder coordination, and a working understanding of the mobility ecosystem. The ideal candidate has 5–7 years of experience in project or program management, with a track record of delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives in mobility, fleet, logistics, or adjacent sectors.
 



  





**What You’ll be Doing** 




 The role exists to own end\-to\-end delivery of mobility projects across the UAE from initial scoping through pilot and into commercial launch. Success is measured by projects delivered on time, within budget, and at the quality standard required for Moove to scale its regional operations.
 



 Within the first 6 months, the role is expected to own at least one active project end\-to\-end, establish clear project governance and reporting cadence for the leadership team, and build the operational frameworks that enable future market launches to be faster and more repeatable.
 



  





 Core Responsibilities
 


* Lead end\-to\-end project management for mobility and automotive projects across the UAE.
* Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, and execution frameworks for new market launches.
* Manage cross\-functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Compliance, Fleet, Safety, and Technology.
* Drive project execution from pilot phase through commercial launch, owning delivery outcomes end\-to\-end.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans; escalate issues proactively to senior leadership.
* Lead vendor management, OEM partner onboarding, and operational integration activities across GCC markets.
* Ensure compliance with transportation, safety, and operational standards.
* Prepare executive dashboards, management reports, operational updates, and board presentations.
* Build scalable operational processes and frameworks to enable faster and more repeatable expansion.
* Perform operational analysis, reporting, forecasting, and data tracking using advanced Excel and BI tools.



  





**What You will need for this position** 



* Experience: 5–7 years in project or program management within mobility, transportation, fleet operations, logistics, or technology; proven track record of delivering cross\-functional projects end\-to\-end in a fast\-paced environment.
* Education / Skills: Bachelor’s in Engineering, Business, Transportation, or Technology; PMP or equivalent preferred; advanced Excel and BI tools proficiency required.
* Traits: Exceptional stakeholder management, highly analytical, comfortable with ambiguity, GCC market\-savvy, strong communicator, and able to lead without authority across complex cross\-functional teams.



  





**Key Metrics** 



* On\-time, on\-budget delivery of mobility projects across UAE.
* Quality and accuracy of executive dashboards, project reporting, and operational updates.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across internal functions and external OEM and technology partners.
* Speed and repeatability of new market launches enabled by scalable operational frameworks.
* Compliance and risk management across all active projects and UAE market operations.



  





**Who You'll Be Working with:** 




 Directly reporting to our Managing Director, and closely working with our UAE Operations Team.
 



  





**About the team** 




 Our team is collaborative, positive, curious, and engaged. We think fast, work smart, laugh often, and are looking for like\-minded people to join us in our mission to disrupt vehicle ownership and make financial freedom within reach.
 



 Moove is strongly committed to diversity within its community. The Company’s approved Employment Equity Plan and Targets will be considered as part of the recruitment process. As an Equal Opportunities employer, we welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently.

**Job Description**
 This role will provide scientific support to the MENAT field team, regional head office Medical Affairs team and external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and be instrumental in establishing and enhancing the company’s reputation with HCPs delivering the required medical information in the interest of benefits of patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Including, but not limited to the following:
   

  

* Identify, develop and maintain collaborative relationships with KOLs, scientific experts and other medical scientific stakeholders.
* Share information with field and head\-office teams regarding communications with KOLs
* Deliver high quality medical and scientific communications in line with defined corporate level and Business Unit communication plans.
* Create and execute center of excellence engagement plan.
* Support affiliate’s Medical and Commercial team in developing local medical tactics and provide input to regional plans if relevant.
* Organize and set up scientific advisory boards with the appropriate key stakeholders.
* Work with local patient access team and in co\-ordination with the HQ patient access function to support local market access, pricing and reimbursement.
* Contribute and support medical scientific aspects in various activities locally and regionally.
* Provide local and regional feedback to regional office when performing Business Development Due Diligence and competitor analysis.
* Delivery input to regional office led medical programs ahead of launch.
* Attend relevant local, regional and global congresses and symposiums to represent Sobi and interact with appropriate stakeholders and customers.
* Ensure ongoing completion of all required initial and ongoing training in local regulations and policies, and adherence to those regulations and policies.
* In coordination with the Medical Director and MSM: Propose, implement and monitor the regional medical action plan (Strategic \& Operational) which includes Phase 3 or 4 studies, investigator studies, post\-authorization studies, promotional and educational medical projects.
* Proactive and timely input into Brand Strategy, plan and budget
* To respond to medical questions from customers and company colleagues
* To ensure initial and continued medical training of field teams
* To validate team’s medical information
* To work with field teams on public relations or symposia with healthcare professionals.
* Liaison with patient advocacy groups.


**Qualifications**
 Education/Learning Experience
   

  

* Required: Bachelor’s degree in a medical field (Pharmacy, Medicine)
* Desired: Postgraduate university degree level education – medical based


 Work Experience
   

  

* Experience within GCC markets is a plus including Saudi
* 8 years \+ of experience in pharmaceutical industry
* 4 years \+ of experience as MSL
* Experience in Endocrinology, Lipidology \& Metabolic therapy areas


 Skills/Knowledge
   

  

* Microsoft office (Excel, PowerPoint \& Word…etc.)
* Ability to Manage diversified portfolio and business complexity.
* Proven track record of achievements \& demonstrated ability to consistently meet and exceed medical KPI's
* Operational Discipline to execute the aligned plans.


 Languages
   

  

* Fluency in written and spoken English \& Arabic is a plus


**Additional Information**
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

* Balance client ambition with operational feasibility — ensuring what gets sold can be delivered



**Delivery \& Standards** 



* Take full ownership of delivery across all accounts, including the transition from new business into execution
* Oversee social media, content production, influencer campaigns, paid performance, and website and editorial content
* Define clear processes and pipelines to deliver each scope item to a high standard
* Challenge output and hold a high bar for creative and strategic quality across all functions
* Understand team strengths and gaps, and step in where needed to support or unblock delivery
* Be comfortable getting hands\-on when required to demonstrate standards or solve execution challenges



**Team Leadership** 



* Manage and develop the social, content, influencer and performance team across London and Dubai
* Set clear expectations and hold the team accountable for performance and delivery
* Provide regular visibility to the Founder \& CEO on team performance, risks and priorities
* Build a culture of ownership, pace and accountability — shifting the team from reactive execution to structured, proactive delivery



**Operations \& Problem Solving** 



* Continuously review workflows, resourcing and delivery structures
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical, scalable solutions
* Expand and improve the agency's network of vendors, tools and capabilities
* Move the team from ad\-hoc execution to structured, repeatable systems over time



**Growth \& New Business** 



* Support the CEO and the Client Growth Manager on new business pitches through strong strategic, creative and operational input
* Shape proposals, scopes and pricing aligned with both client ambition and delivery capability
* Contribute ideas to improve the agency's offering, positioning and commercial structure



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* 7–10 years in a digital marketing agency environment, with at least 2–3 years at a senior account or director level
* Strong working knowledge across social media, content, influencer marketing, paid performance and website content — you don't need to execute everything, but you need to know what good looks like
* Proven experience owning client relationships and driving account growth, not just managing delivery
* Experience managing and developing junior and mid\-level team members
* Commercially aware — strong understanding of scope, resourcing and how to protect margin
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, lean agency — this is not a corporate role
* Experience working with premium or luxury brands — you understand the standard these clients expect
* Based in Dubai with UK market experience, or based in the UK with proven UAE market experience
* Highly solutions\-oriented, with a bias for action and ownership over process



  





**A Note from the Founder** 





 This role is central to the next stage of growth at Techne across London, Dubai and New York.
 





 I'm looking for someone who can take ownership of client delivery, elevate standards across the team and help build a more scalable and structured way of operating — without losing the pace and quality that defines how we work.
 





 This is not a hands\-off or purely strategic role. You'll be expected to lead from the front, bring solutions and step into execution when needed. If you're looking for a highly structured corporate environment, this likely isn't the right fit. If you're motivated by ownership, pace and building something, we should speak.

data.jd_text:
At Genius we are hiring for a role of
 **Manager Operations\-\-Home Delivery** 
 for a leading FMCG client
 



**Location Dubai** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Delivery Operations Management
 


* Oversee and manage end\-to\-end delivery operations across all outlets and brands.
* Ensure compliance with company standards, food safety regulations, and operational procedures.
* Maintain delivery infrastructure readiness, including staffing, systems, packaging, and logistics processes.
* Monitor and improve operational KPIs including SLA adherence, delivery delays, cancellations, refunds, customer ratings, and order accuracy.
* Identify and resolve operational bottlenecks in coordination with outlet management teams.
* Conduct regular operational audits to ensure consistency and service excellence.



 2\. Aggregator \& Partner Management
 


* Manage relationships with third\-party delivery aggregators and logistics partners.
* Negotiate commercial terms, commissions, service level agreements (SLAs), and partnership conditions.
* Monitor promotional campaigns, marketing activities, and platform visibility.
* Optimize advertising spend, discount structures, and promotional ROI.
* Ensure partner compliance and resolve operational or technical issues promptly.



 3\. Sales, Marketing \& Growth
 


* Drive delivery sales growth and profitability across all brands and markets.
* Plan and execute delivery\-focused marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Analyze campaign performance and implement strategies to maximize ROI.
* Support the development and expansion of dark kitchens and virtual brands.
* Optimize menu engineering, pricing strategies, and product availability to maximize revenue.



 4\. Customer Experience Management
 


* Manage and resolve escalated customer complaints related to delivery operations.
* Monitor customer feedback trends and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure accurate documentation, tracking, and resolution of customer feedback and service issues.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and service quality standards.



 5\. Reporting \& Analytics
 


* Prepare and present daily, weekly, and monthly operational and commercial reports.
* Analyze sales performance, delivery KPIs, customer behavior, and operational trends.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for business improvement.
* Develop dashboards and performance tracking mechanisms to support data\-driven decision\-making.



 6\. Compliance \& Quality Assurance
 


* Ensure adherence to company policies, operational standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Conduct regular audits and compliance checks across all delivery operations.
* Maintain and improve quality assurance processes to ensure consistent service standards.



 7\. Contract Management
 


* Manage contracts and agreements with delivery aggregators, logistics providers, and external partners.
* Track contract renewals, compliance obligations, and commercial performance.
* Ensure all agreements align with company objectives and operational requirements.



 8\. Strategic Planning \& Expansion
 


* Support new outlet openings, market expansions, and brand launches.
* Conduct feasibility studies and operational assessments for new delivery initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for operational efficiency, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to long\-term delivery growth strategies and business development initiatives.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Delivery sales and order growth
* SLA and delivery time adherence
* Customer satisfaction and ratings
* Order accuracy and cancellation rates
* Refund and complaint reduction
* Cost control and operational efficiency
* Campaign performance and ROI
* Aggregator relationship performance
* Profitability of delivery operations



 Qualifications \& Requirements
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Minimum 10\+ years of experience in delivery operations, food service, QSR, or multi\-unit operations management.
* Strong understanding of delivery aggregators, food delivery platforms, and logistics operations.
* Proven experience in KPI management, sales growth, and operational optimization.
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and operational dashboards.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, multi\-market environment.

Müller's Solutions is seeking an experienced and results\-driven

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Take full responsibility for the overall delivery of the ServiceNow platform services, encompassing:
   

  

* Continuous operations and support, ensuring the platform is always available, reliable, and performing optimally to meet organizational needs

* Coordination of releases and deployments, managing schedules, resources, and communication to guarantee smooth transitions and minimal disruption


 Serve as the main escalation point and decision\-maker for delivery\-related issues, ensuring that:
   

  

* Problems are resolved quickly through effective troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and engagement with relevant teams
* Risks are effectively controlled by proactively identifying potential issues and implementing mitigation strategies
* Delivery obligations are fulfilled in accordance with agreed timelines, quality standards, and contract requirements


 Collaborate closely with stakeholders to:
   

  

* Comprehend and prioritize demands, balancing competing needs to deliver maximum value to the organization
* Question and verify requirements when necessary, ensuring clarity, feasibility, and alignment with strategic goals
* Guarantee alignment between business objectives and platform capabilities, facilitating seamless integration and optimal use of ServiceNow features


 Provide strong leadership to the delivery teams, which include:
   

  

* Technical consultants and developers, guiding them to apply best practices, innovate, and maintain high code quality
* Business analysts, supporting requirement gathering, documentation, and communication between business and technical teams
* QA and support personnel, ensuring thorough testing, issue identification, and responsive support services


 Lead delivery governance and uphold standards, ensuring:
   

  

* Consistent development practices that adhere to organizational policies and industry standards
* Controlled release processes that minimize risk, ensure quality, and provide clear documentation
* Alignment to platform design and reuse principles, promoting efficient, maintainable, and scalable solutions


 Ensure quality and accountability across delivery, including:
   

  

* Reviewing progress against commitments, conducting regular status meetings and reporting to stakeholders
* Monitoring delivery KPIs and SLAs, analyzing performance data to identify trends and areas for improvement
* Supporting issue resolution and performance improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction


 Act as a trusted point of contact for stakeholders, capable of:
   

  

* Representing technical and functional decisions clearly and effectively, bridging communication between business and IT teams
* Managing expectations and resolving conflicts diplomatically to maintain positive relationships and project momentum
* Standing behind delivery teams with confidence, advocating for resources, and providing guidance to overcome challenges


 Support continuous improvement of service delivery, including:
   

  

* Identifying inefficiencies and bottlenecks through regular process reviews and feedback collection
* Driving optimisation of processes and workflows to increase efficiency, reduce costs, and improve user experience
* Promoting effective use of ServiceNow capabilities by encouraging adoption of new features, best practices, and ongoing training


**Requirements**
**7 to 10\+ years of experience in Service Delivery, with extensive knowledge of ServiceNow**
**platforms, including:**
* In\-depth understanding of various ServiceNow modules and features such as:
+ ITSM
+ ITOM / CMDB
+ HRSD / enterprise services
+ CSM


**Capable of:**
* Confidently engaging with both technical teams and business stakeholders
* Critically evaluating requirements and assumptions when necessary
* Converting high\-level requirements into actionable delivery strategies


**Demonstrated experience in managing:**
* Multiple ServiceNow delivery streams, including operations and enhancements
* Backlog\-driven development prioritization
* Cross\-functional teams


**Strong knowledge of:**
* Service delivery models and governance frameworks
* Management of SLAs and KPIs
* Release and change management procedures


**Ability to:**
* Assertively participate in stakeholder discussions and justify delivery decisions
* Effectively support and represent delivery teams
* Maintain control in complex or high\-pressure situations


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* ITIL Foundation or higher certification
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or other relevant certifications
* Experience working with Agile methodologies and project management tools
* Familiarity with automation and workflow optimization within the ServiceNow platform


**Benefits**
 1\- Attractive Package.
   

  

 2\- Family Benefits.

 4\-Air Tickets.

**About IC Markets** 




 IC Markets Global is one of the most renowned Forex CFD provider, offering trading solutions for active day traders and scalpers as well as traders that are new to the forex market. IC Markets Global offers its clients cutting edge trading platforms, low latency connectivity and superior liquidity.
 



 IC Markets Global is revolutionizing online forex trading. Traders are now able to gain access to pricing previously only available to investment banks and high net worth individuals.
 



 Our management team have significant experience in the Forex, CFD and Equity markets in Asia, Europe and North America. It is this experience that has enabled us to select the best possible technology solutions and hand pick some of the best pricing providers available in the market.
 



  





**Role Overview:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of complex, high\-impact programmes across multiple engineering teams. This senior role is the critical connective layer between engineering, product, architecture, and leadership. responsible for resolving cross\-team dependencies, driving delivery of intricate technical projects, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality outcomes at scale. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency combined with exceptional programme management skills, and thrives in navigating ambiguity across distributed, multi\-disciplinary teams within a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Cross\-Team Dependency \& Complex Delivery Management** 



* Own and drive resolution of cross\-team technical dependencies across 8–12\+ engineering squads
* Establish and maintain programme\-level dependency maps, risk registers, and escalation paths
* Lead planning and execution of complex, multi\-team deliveries spanning months or multiple quarters
* Identify inter\-team blockers early and orchestrate timely resolution with engineering leads and architects
* Coordinate integration milestones, shared API contracts, and platform\-level dependencies across squads



  





**Delivery \& Release Governance** 



* Define and enforce delivery governance frameworks for large\-scale technical programmes
* Ensure production readiness through structured release checkpoints, go/no\-go criteria, and sign\-off processes
* Oversee end\-to\-end release management across parallel workstreams, coordinating across QA, DevOps, and Platform teams
* Monitor programme health, critical path, and execution risks; escalate proactively to leadership
* Drive standardization of release and deployment governance across the engineering organization



  





**Technical Programme Leadership** 



* Partner with Engineering Leads, Principal Engineers, and Architects to translate technical strategy into actionable delivery plans
* Lead structured programme ceremonies: dependency syncs, architecture reviews, cross\-team planning, and programme\-level retrospectives
* Maintain and evolve Agile and hybrid delivery frameworks tailored to programme complexity and team maturity
* Drive PI Planning and large\-scale increment coordination across product and platform squads



  





**Stakeholder \& Executive Engagement** 



* Serve as the primary delivery interface for senior stakeholders, CTO, and executive leadership on complex programmes
* Produce clear, data\-driven programme status reports, risk dashboards, and delivery forecasts for leadership review
* Translate complex technical interdependencies into business\-level impact narratives for non\-technical audiences
* Proactively manage expectations, surface trade\-offs, and recommend delivery options under constraint.



  





**Tooling \& Delivery Intelligence** 



* Own and evolve programme\-level Jira structures including epics hierarchies, dependency links, cross\-project boards, and automation
* Drive delivery intelligence through advanced metrics: cycle time, lead time, flow efficiency, dependency resolution SLAs.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that surface programme health, risk, and delivery confidence
* Ensure tooling practices support audit readiness and compliance requirements in a regulated financial services environment



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* 10\+ years in Technical Delivery Management, Programme Management, or Engineering Leadership roles
* Proven track record delivering complex, multi\-team technical programmes in a regulated or high\-stakes environment
* Deep expertise in cross\-team dependency management across large engineering organizations (8\+ teams)
* Strong technical fluency; ability to engage credibly with engineers, architects, and platform teams on technical trade\-offs
* Extensive experience with Agile at scale frameworks and hybrid delivery models
* Advanced Jira administration, programme\-level workflow design, and delivery metrics expertise
* Proven experience driving complex release governance across distributed, parallel workstreams
* Experience working in fintech, trading platforms, or high\-frequency, regulated product environments strongly preferred
* Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity and driving clarity in a fast\-paced, high\-complexity environment

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction
   

  

* Work closely with Engg, Manufacturing systems manager, supply chain and purchasing on new product industrialisation in a timely manner


 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness


**Role Context**
 The Plant Director operates within a manufacturing environment serving utility, infrastructure, and industrial customers across the Middle East and export markets. The role leads a multi disciplinary operations organisation, overseeing manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance, and HSE, within a competitive, cost sensitive, and delivery driven market.
   

  

 Reporting to the Manufacturing Operations Director, the role works in close collaboration with regional Sales, Projects, Engineering, Procurement, and corporate functions to align plant capability with customer demand, strategic growth plans, and localisation requirements. The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability
   

  

**Qualifications, Experience \& Skills**
* Bachelor’s degree or above in management, electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering or related fields.
* Understand manufacturing business, people management, supply chain management, financial management, quality management, and innovation.
* Possess experience in middle or senior management minimum of 10\-15 years.


**Job\-Specific Skills**
* Communication
* Values and respects others, Building relationships, Teamwork
* Process Loss Elimination Techniques
* Continuous improvement
* Project Management
* Creative Thinking
* Change Innovation
* Develops others
* Builds successful teams, Supports \& coaches the team
* Consulting skills
* Visionary leadership
* Achieving results, Customer driven
* Critical decision making
* Develops organisation budgets
* Organizational safety
* Financial astuteness
* Broad experience of developing and implementing short to long\-range objectives and strategies to achieve business goals.
* Proven capability of operating successfully at a senior management level.
* Understanding of electrical mechanical design engineering, competence in electrical power engineering.
* Demonstrate financial acumen including planning and cost control capabilities and proven experience of managing projects to budget.
* Proven track record in delivering manufacturing and supply chain best practice
* Strong working ethic in the delivery of satisfying the profitable requirements and expectations of internal and external customers.
* Effectively recognise and manage conflict
* Broad experience of working in a multi\-national, matrix organisation.
* Strong communications and presentation skills.
* Strong English written and verbal communication skills.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Creates strong team \& guiding partner
* Promotes team accountability \& strong sense of understanding
* Is always curious \& goes beyond obvious
* Finds useful benchmarks \& does effective research
* Is open and candid about work situation
* Acts in a manner consistent with values
* Targets new opportunities \& sets clear objectives
* Commits to continuous improvement
* Expresses positive attitude toward teamwork
* Collects wisdom by sharing experiences and goals
* Provides task\-orientated and helpful instructions
* Provides behavioural feedback, coaching
* Facilitates open communications
* Proactively acts to gain customer trust
* Sees connections, relations, trends and patterns
* Applies learned concepts and think of new so to create a circle of learning.


 \#Lucy Electric

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our Agile Delivery team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

**The** 
**Agile Delivery Manager** 
**is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.**
**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.
* Lead the Integrated Programme Planning (Lean Start Up). Working with portfolio teams and supporting the Technical Product Manager, drive and facilitate decomposition of Epic Roadmaps into Integrated Program backlog/plans (Features), ready for hand off into team level backlogs.
* Drive Quality and ensure the Definition of Done (DOD) is being followed; ensures each team member is fully engaged in the stories and making a meaningful contribution. Encourage a sustainable pace adhering to the agreed quality management plan with the team. Maintain an agile project management tool (e.g. ScrumDesk, JIRA, etc.).
* Assist in team development through holding teams accountable for their commitments, removing roadblocks to their work; leveraging cross functional team skills to improve product backlog throughput; and mentoring and developing team members.  To manage the facilities and operations within the assigned portfolio of assets/ buildings while implementing best supplier and customer relationship management, facilities management, building energy services management, maintenance, and contract management practices that improve the overall operational efficiency of managed assets, maintain high customer satisfaction,

* Contribute and assist the director of operations in defining an optimum structure for the business unit/ division so that resources are optimally utilized, and communication takes place in an efficient manner.
* Recommend and oversee the budget for the business unit and monitor financial performance versus the budget so that the business is aware of anticipated costs/ revenues, areas of unsatisfactory performance and potential areas of cost reduction are identified, and performance improvement opportunities are realized.

* Develop and monitor SLAs for the assets, and ensure that they are aligned to service delivery, client expectations, and expectations from suppliers / service partners in order to achieve quality service delivery, effective supplier relationship management, and profitability.

* Monitor resource utilization to ensure that the right number and talent is available for running operations as well as minor projects, mechanical \& HVAC works, electrical works, etc.), accomplishing targets, improving customer satisfaction, and achieving business objectives.
* Monitor and control the execution of maintenance contracts, review the preventive and corrective maintenance programs, and supervise the implementation by employees or assigned contractor(s) through reviewing reports and spot\-checking as appropriate to ensure the provision of quality maintenance works to the facilities (including maintenance to equipment, Turbines, Generators, Chillers, HVAC, pumps, sewage lifting stations, substations, infrastructure networks, etc.).

* Manage customers’ expectations through clear communication and transparent work attitude in order to be consistent and to develop strong customer relationships.
* Receive escalated problems and complaints from the Call Centre and ensure that the necessary support and maintenance work is provided to customers in a timely fashion in order to resolve customers’ issues (pertaining to cooling, power interruptions, ventilation, plumbing, etc.) and maintain their high levels of satisfaction.
* Escort customers on daily tours within the premises/ facilities, listen to any feedback or complaints they might have, and delegate any work needed to the subordinates in order to provide customers with the necessary civil, mechanical, electrical, etc. support and maintenance support.
* Provide technical advice to customers and represent customers in technical interfaces with third parties (such as dealing with contractors conducting any construction work on premises while ensuring that they are delivering according to the agreement) as well as furnish customers with technical advice on improvement opportunities (such as reducing utility consumption and bills) in order to increase CSR awareness and contribute in achieving a greener environment.
* Manage the implementation and improvement of policies, guidelines, and processes for contract management and administration to ensure standards are set so that all business requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality service to customers in line with the corporate strategy.
* Manage the process of revising contracts’ scope of work, renewing the contract while recommending changes, conducting pricing, and negotiating the contract with the customer while coordinating the Terms \& Conditions of the contract with the Legal department to ensure alignment with internal policies and any external laws and regulations.
* Lead and monitor the subcontracting of works (such as fire systems, gas, emergency lighting, vertical transportation, water treatment, tank cleaning, etc.), ensure that subcontractors fulfil their duties in an accurate manner and as per the agreed upon contractual clauses, and manage subcontractors’ evaluations and negotiations while ensuring that chosen subcontractors are approved by the relevant authorities to guarantee compliance with the regulatory framework (such as any approvals needed from the Civil Defense Department for fire\-fighting systems)
* Ensure effective planning and implementation of HSEEQ inspections and audits in order to meet regulatory requirements and company standards.
* Monitor physical and documentation audits being conducted on subcontractors to ensure that work is being conducted properly and that customers are being served with the highest quality standards, and take the necessary actions upon the detection of unreported/ undisclosed variations and/ or poor performance to safeguard the company against any liabilities.
* Lead the audits of staff, customers, and suppliers to gather feedback and monitor satisfaction in order to improve the operations and facilities management services Enova provides.
* Develop and ensure the implementation of division policies, procedures, and controls covering all areas of activity so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.
* Ensure compliance to all relevant quality, health, safety, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls across the department to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high quality products/ service and a responsible environmental attitude.
* Ensure corrective actions and preventive actions issued by the HSEEQ department are implemented, update the HSEEQ department about the progress of the implementation

* Ensure the HIRAs are finalized and yearly updated, with support of the HSEQ department
* Ensure the risk control measures arising from the HIRA are properly implemented
* Ensure availability of MS and RA for outsourced works
* Ensure relevant emergency tests are conducted
* Ensure that all departmental reports are prepared timely and accurately and meet requirements, policies, and standards.

**Qualifications, Experiences, \& Skills**



* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical, preferably with a Master’s degree in Management or Facilities Management; CMMS knowledge is also preferable
* 10 – 12 years’ experience in operations management including 5 years in a managerial role; exposure to Maintenance and Facilities Management especially in Malls /Hospitality projects

data.jd_text:
We are looking for a Resident Architect to join our DSA team in Dubai.
 



  





**1\. Role Overview**




  





 To lead the on\-site architectural supervision and consultant services for major construction projects. This includes the administration of post\-contract responsibilities as defined by the appointment, managing and coordinating multidisciplinary site teams where applicable, ensuring alignment with the approved design intent, and monitoring compliance with the project’s contract, codes, and specifications. When appointed in a Design Guardian capacity, the role is limited to safeguarding the design intent through review, coordination, and advisory input only, and does not include construction supervision, inspection, certification, contract administration, or Defects Liability Period services unless expressly agreed and appointed under a separate scope. The role serves as a primary interface between the client, contractors, design teams, and other stakeholders. The exact scope of services may differ on a project\-by\-project basis and will be further defined as part of the project\-specific deliverables..
 



  





**2\.Job Accountabilities Linked To Objectives**




  





 The Resident Architect is responsible for leading the on\-site project team and driving the successful delivery of the project. As the most senior project representative for DSA on site, this role carries the critical responsibility of safeguarding the company’s interests, contractual, legal, and commercial responsibilities throughout the construction phase and ensuring the project aligns with DSA’s standards and obligations.
 



  





 The Resident Architect may be assigned responsibilities across one or multiple projects, as well as strategic or special initiatives aligned with the company's broader objectives. These special assignments may extend beyond project\-specific duties and can include tasks such as conducting quality audits, developing procedures, manuals and supporting internal process improvements \& development.
 



  





 In all cases, the Resident Architect is expected to work closely, not only with their direct team/ the Client but also with their immediate supervisor and line manager to clearly define the scope of responsibilities, deliverables, and resource requirements specific to each assignment. The final scope of duties and level of authority will be established in consultation with and subject to approval by the Site Operations Director, Project Director or relevant senior leadership.
 



  





**A. Design Site Leadership** 




 • Lead the site\-based lead consultancy team (where present) to ensure high standards of quality, compliance, coordination, and delivery across all stakeholders, proactively addressing deficiencies as they arise.
 



 • Oversee and assist with design deliverables, pre\-engineering, shop drawings, RFIs, submittals, inspections, and construction queries to support timely resolution and adherence to project requirements.
 



 • Review and approve works, including but not limited to mock\-ups, sample rooms, materials, and finishes, ensuring alignment with the approved design / designer, specifications, and project requirements.
 



 • Ensure effective design coordination across all disciplines and contribute to the resolution of design and construction\-related conflicts.
 



 • Conduct regular architectural and design\-focused site walks to monitor the implementation of the approved design intent, including look, feel, materiality, and spatial quality.
 



 • Identify, document, and report design, aesthetic, and quality\-related risks or non\-compliances to the LDC / Client through structured observations and reporting.
 



 • Prepare and issue monthly architectural / design guardianship reports summarising site observations, key risks, and matters requiring attention.
 



 • Review and provide comments on material samples, mock\-ups, mood boards, finishes, look \& feel assessments, and sample rooms to support alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Provide architectural and interior design clarifications, including aesthetic and design intent matters, where requested by the Client.
 



 • Participate in value engineering and design development discussions, providing input on architectural quality, aesthetic impact, and alignment with the approved design intent.
 



 • Coordinate closely with PMCM, the Contractor, and the wider consultant team during site reviews, technical meetings, and design discussions to maintain alignment between design intent, construction execution, and client expectations.
 



 • Monitor that the executed works reflect the approved design, client expectations, and applicable codes and regulations throughout the construction process.
 



 • Ensure RFIs, approvals, instructions, and IFC changes are managed through the established project communication and authority channels and are properly coordinated across all parties.
 



 • Produce and issue timely internal and external dashboards capturing progress, quality, design alignment, and emerging risks.
 



  





**B. Site Supervision Team Management** 




 • Direct and manage the day\-to\-day performance of DSA's site supervision team (architects, engineers, inspectors, sub\-consultants and the like).
 



 • Ensure all team members are properly briefed on their roles and responsibilities.
 



 • Implement structured delegation and reporting mechanisms.
 



 • Conduct periodic audits, QA/QC / technical reviews, and performance assessments.
 



 • Maintain a collaborative, professional, and high\-performing supervision environment on site.
 



 • Ensure employees / team members conduct are upheld to the highest standards
 



 • Monitor and update in coordination with the Client and Site Operations Director the project, staff deployment, associated schedule and ensure timely delivery of the same at the agreed frequency
 



  





**C. Project \& Contract Administration** 




 • Oversee compliance with the project’s construction contract (FIDIC or equivalent).
 



 • Issue formal communications, manage variations, evaluate contractor claims, and contribute to extension of time assessments.
 



 • Ensure proper documentation, records \& communication protocols are established, used and maintained for all supervision activities.
 



 • Coordinate with the Employer’s Representative and Client\-appointed Consultants.
 



 • Act as Engineer’s Representative / Employer’s Representative if appointed, ensuring responsibilities are discharged in line with the delegated authority.
 



 • Assist in stake holder and lead in team dispute resolution
 



  





**D. Project Coordination \& Stakeholder Interface** 




 • Act as the senior site representative of the lead consultant.
 



 • Establish and manage coordination mechanisms among the consultant team, contractor, suppliers, and client representatives.
 



 • Participate in progress meetings, site coordination meetings, and technical reviews.
 



 • Monitor and steer project progress and associated scheduling and produce relevant reports
 



 • Provide strategic input and advice to the client to ensure project objectives are met.
 



  





**E. Quality \& Compliance Oversight** 




 • Enforce quality control standards and escalate issues that risk the design quality or compliance of the project / deliverables
 



 • Monitor health, safety, and environmental practices on site.
 



 • Participate in final inspections, testing, and commissioning phases.
 



 • Ensure defect lists, non\-conformance reports and site observations are compiled and rectified in line with contract obligations.
 



 • Ensure pre\-engineering deliverables are in line with contract agreement and implement measures to maintain and or rectify resulting shortfalls
 



 • Monitor and advise on change control process
 



  





**F. Leadership \& Mentorship** 




 • Serve as mentor and technical advisor to staff, engineers and sub\-consultants.
 



 • Lead internal training and onboarding of new site staff.
 



 • Foster a knowledge\-sharing culture that emphasizes continuous improvement and professional development to the benefit of the project and company.
 



  





**G. Commercial \& Invoicing Responsibilities** 




 • Coordinate with the head office/accounts team to prepare and validate monthly consultancy service invoices in line with contract terms.
 



 • Review and confirm site\-based and related staff, timesheets for inclusion in monthly billing.
 



 • Collect, verify, and consolidate sub\-consultant timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and scope alignment.
 



 • Track sub\-consultant invoices and ensure timely submission to accounts for processing.
 



 • Maintain a project\-specific log of all invoicing activities, including issue dates, payment terms, and receipt confirmations amongst others.
 



 • Monitor outstanding invoices and follow up with clients and relevant stakeholders to ensure prompt payment.
 



 • Flag and escalate delays in payment or disputed invoices to the Project Director and commercial team.
 



 • Liaise with sub\-consultants regarding their payment status and provide updates on payment cycles and client approvals.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal financial procedures and contractual invoicing requirements.
 



 • Support monthly project \& financial reporting with updates on invoice status, forecasted income, and payment risks.
 



 • Assist in reconciling client payment records with internal accounts to resolve discrepancies, if any.
 



 • Track any approved variations or scope changes and coordinate with the commercial team to ensure these are invoiced accordingly.
 



  





**3\. Qualification / Experience / Requirements**




  





 • Qualified Architect (BArch / MArch) with minimum 15 years’ experience; at least 10 years on\-site in the Middle East.
 



 • Proven experience as a Resident Architect on large\-scale or complex projects.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of FIDIC contract administration and construction management practices.
 



 • Experience managing multidisciplinary supervision teams in fast\-track environments.
 



 • Familiar with UAE/ Regional Authority codes, regulations, and approval procedures.
 



 • PMP, MCIOB, or similar certifications are advantageous.
 



 • Strong documentation, reporting, technical and problem\-solving capabilities.
 



  





 Interested candidates can share their resume directly on recruit.dxb@dsa\-arch.com mentioning "Resident Architect" as a subject.

 We’re creating
 **OneState** 
 , a mobile life simulator built in Unity.  If you are seeking to be a part of an engaged team, work on captivating projects with minimal bureaucracy, and receive regular, constructive feedback, then you’ll find your place with us.

* Experience as an Art Director or Head of Art on game projects
* Strong expertise in mobile AAA realism
* Deep understanding of mobile platform limitations and how to work within them
* Experience building art systems, standards, and processes
* Experience collaborating with producers and directors as partners
* Strong skills in presenting and defending creative decisions
* Cross platform experience with mobile, PC, or console projects is a strong plus

The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. ****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management

* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
* 
+ Support contract negotiations on technical clauses and deviations.

* Quality, Safety \& Compliance (Non\-Negotiables)
+ Ensure all engineering outputs comply with international standards including:
+ IEC 60255
+ IEC 61850
+ IEC 61131
+ IEC 61439
+ IEEE C37
+ ISO 9001

**Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering (Master’s preferred).**

**Knowledge \& Technical Expertise**

+ Deep expertise in protection schemes (Differential, Distance, REF, Overcurrent, Busbar).
+ Relay coordination , system studies, and CT/VT sizing.

* Panel \& System Design
+ LV/MV panel design, heat dissipation, segregation, earthing, and wiring philosophy.

* Automation \& Communication
