**Role Summary**
 The Customer Service Manager (CSM) is responsible for the day\-to\-day performance and stability of customer service operations in a fast\-paced fintech environment. This role requires a hands\-on, data\-driven leader with experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, capable of translating operational data into actionable insights. The CSM will drive service performance through queue management, capacity planning, root cause analysis (RCA), and Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, while working closely with internal teams and outsourced partners to deliver consistent, compliant, and high\-quality customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy \& Insights (CSM Level)**
* Analyse customer service performance metrics including SLA, FCR, CSAT, NPS, AHT, backlog, abandonment, and repeat contacts
* Identify trends and drivers behind performance movements and translate them into clear operational actions
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for key issue types (e.g. remittance status checks, escalations, repeat contacts)
* Own and contribute to Voice of Customer (VoC) insights, highlighting recurring customer pain points and improvement opportunities
* Provide structured, insight\-led updates to the Head of Customer Service and senior stakeholders.


**Operational Service Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day customer service operations across voice, tickets, email, and in\-app support channels
* Oversee high\-volume call centre operations, ensuring queue health, responsiveness, and service stability
* Monitor ticket backlogs, ageing, and abandonment rates, taking corrective action where required
* Manage escalations, including coordination with internal teams and third\-party partners
* Lead and participate in daily stand\-ups to track performance, risks, and priorities


**Capacity Planning \& Workforce Management**
* Track service demand versus available capacity by channel and product
* Identify capacity gaps and support short\-term and medium\-term workforce planning
* Monitor agent productivity, utilisation, and adherence
* Support SLA and KPI discussions with outsourced partners using data\-backed insights


**CRM \& Process Discipline**
* Ensure consistent and accurate use of the CRM, including: a) Ticket logging and categorisation b) Status updates and escalation handling c) Routing and workflow adherence
* Maintain strong data hygiene to support reliable reporting and analysis
* Identify process inefficiencies or system gaps based on hands\-on operational experience


**People Leadership \& Team Enablement**
* Provide hands\-on coaching and real\-time guidance to agents and team leads
* Reinforce service quality standards, communication best practices, and escalation protocols
* Act as a first point of support for complex or sensitive customer cases
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus


**Requirements**
* Proven experience managing high\-volume call centre and digital support operations, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services
* Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance metrics and drive actions
* Hands\-on experience with CRM systems (ticketing, routing, reporting)
* Experience leading RCA and VoC analysis to drive service and process improvements.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including collaboration with Product, Tech, Risk, and outsourced partners.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment Desirable.
* Experience working with outsourced BPO partners.
* Exposure to fintech products such as payments, wallets, lending, or merchant services.
* Understanding of regulatory and compliance considerations in customer service operations. Success Measures
* Improved SLA, FCR, CSAT, and abandonment performance
* Reduced backlog and ageing tickets.
* Clear, actionable RCA and VoC insights influencing operational improvements.
* Stable and predictable day\-to\-day service delivery.
* Improved agent productivity and consistency

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
 Our Engineering Planning and IT Systems is a strategically critical function within Emirates Engineering, responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and cost\-effective maintenance of one of the world’s largest and most technologically advanced aircraft fleets.
   

  

 The division leads maintenance planning, reliability oversight, asset lifecycle management, and engineering digital systems to maximise fleet availability, optimise cost performance, and support informed decision\-making. By combining operational excellence with digital innovation, the function plays a central role in delivering Emirates’ Commercial Operating Plan, enabling long\-term fleet growth, and sustaining industry\-leading standards of safety, reliability, and efficiency.
   

  

 If you are passionate about leading complex operations, driving transformation, and delivering technology\-enabled solutions at scale, we invite you to apply and contribute to the continued success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 As the
 **Vice President – Engineering Planning \& IT Systems** 
 you will, provide strategic and operational leadership for Engineering Planning and Engineering IT Systems across the Emirates fleet. The role ensures safe, compliant, cost‑effective, and future‑ready maintenance planning, asset lifecycle management, and digital enablement, supporting the Commercial Operating Plan and long‑term fleet strategy. Leads large, multi‑disciplinary teams and drives continuous improvement, innovation and capability building in line with Emirates’ values and growth ambitions.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Define and lead long, medium and short‑term engineering and maintenance planning strategies to ensure optimal fleet availability, regulatory compliance, and alignment with the Commercial Operating Plan.
* Oversee maintenance planning, work packaging, scheduling, production support, and technical records to ensure safe, efficient and economical execution across aircraft, engines, and components in line with airworthiness requirements.
* Own planned maintenance cost performance and manpower planning for Engineering Planning and IT Systems; partner with P\&L on MRO sourcing, contract negotiation, and capacity optimisation, including third‑party opportunities.
* Chair the Engineering Reliability Committee to monitor fleet technical performance, proactively address emerging risks, and drive sustained improvement in dispatch reliability and asset health.
* Lead asset lifecycle planning, including modification programmes and end‑of‑lease transitions, ensuring contractual compliance, minimal financial exposure and optimal commercial outcomes.
* Define and deliver the Engineering IT Systems strategy to enhance productivity, data integrity and decision‑making; ensure effective system support and continuous improvement in partnership with internal technology providers.
* Provide leadership to a large, diverse workforce; shape fit‑for‑purpose organisational structures, strengthen succession and talent pipelines, and actively develop future capabilities, with a strong focus on Emiratization development.

**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
 SC Ventures is Standard Chartered’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served.
   

  

 We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together.
   

  

 We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy \& Lifestyle, SMEs \& World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability \& Inclusion.
   

  

 We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The Innovation and Venture Designer is a senior individual contributor at the forefront of shaping what banking can become next. Reporting to and supporting the Head of Innovation and Design, this role will define, design, and deliver customer\-centric digital and service experiences across the SC Ventures portfolio, turning bold ideas into ventures that can scale in market.
   

  

 This is a role for someone energised by change, ambiguity, and the challenge of building in fast\-moving markets. The role holder will apply human\-centred design and product design expertise to unlock better customer outcomes, accelerate venture validation, and strengthen product\-market fit. The role carries Director\-level accountability, autonomy, and influence, working closely with venture CEOs, product leaders, engineers, and senior stakeholders to shape high\-impact decisions.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
**Proposition Shaping**
* Support the shaping of bold, differentiated venture concepts grounded in emerging trends across AI, fintech, and digital business models.
* Apply strong commercial acumen and customer insight to focus efforts on high\-potential opportunity spaces and translate them into compelling venture hypotheses.
* Work closely with venture leads, technologists, investors, and senior stakeholders to develop and refine co\-created early\-stage venture ideas.
* Leverage AI augmentation and modern design tools to accelerate ideation, concept development, and early prototyping.


**Proposition Validation**
* Turn bold venture ideas into tangible prototypes that can be tested with real users and evaluated for seed investment by the Investment Committee.
* Run fast, hands\-on validation cycles to test assumptions, gather customer insight, and build robust evidence for or against investment decisions.
* Rapidly design, prototype, and iterate using modern tools including Figma and AI tools such as Claude.
* Translate complex ideas into clear, compelling narratives and artifacts that are simple, decision\-ready, and investment\-grade.


**Product Design \& Venture Build**
* Apply strong UX, service design, and prototyping craft to move from ambiguity to clarity at speed, shaping intuitive and high\-impact user experiences.
* Support ventures post\-seed by refining early\-stage product, user journeys, and experience design.
* Create prototypes and product concepts that bridge strategy, technology, and customer experience.
* Embed AI augmentation into product design to enhance user value, differentiation, and scalability.
* Ensure alignment between customer needs, business viability, and technical feasibility across early\-stage product development.


**Overall Mindset**
* Be comfortable operating in zero\-to\-one environments, balancing creativity, speed, and rigour.
* Bring a solid understanding of fintech ecosystems and digital business models, with sound commercial judgment.
* Thrive in a fast\-moving, experimental environment where building, testing, and learning quickly matters most..


**Risk Management**
* Adhere to Policies and Procedures.
* Act and escalate quickly when any risk and control weakness become apparent and ensure they are addressed within an appropriate timeframe and escalated through the relevant committees.
* Work with SCV colleagues to deliver expected business performance results within cost constraints and applicable risk/ control framework to ensure that the Group’s ability to remain within risk appetite is not materially threatened.


**Governance**
* Have an awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Head of Innovation and Design
* Venture leads
* SC Ventures leadership


**Other Responsibilities**
* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.


**Skills And Experience**
* Influence
* UX/UI Design
* Innovation
* Business Acumen
* Strategic Thinking


**Qualifications**
* 10\+ years’ experience across facilitation, product design, product commercialisation, innovation design, UX/UI and/or consulting
* Experience working in AI augmented or automation rich product environments, leveraging AI tools or agents to accelerate discovery and delivery
* Ability to define intent, constraints, and evaluation criteria for AI generated outputs across design and innovation workflows
* Strong systems thinking: comfortable designing workflows, guardrails, and governance rather than only artefacts
* Proven track record designing complex, customer\-facing digital products at scale
* Strong expertise in UX research, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping (Claude Code/Cursor in addition to Figma)
* Experience operating at Director\-level influence without formal people management
* Strong understanding of agile product development and cross\-functional delivery models
* Ability to clearly articulate design decisions to senior, non\-design stakeholders


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market\-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first\-aiders and all sorts of self\-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies \- everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommerce with defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the Senior eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 5\+ years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes.  As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Senior Manager \- Commercial Asset Management** 
 . In this role, you will be responsible for maximizing the value and performance of Shamal Holding’s hospitality asset portfolio. The role involves strategic oversight of hotel operators, performance monitoring, capital planning, and ensuring that the assets meet financial and operational targets. The role will also support new acquisitions, expansions and developments by providing asset\-level insights and lead execution of projects.
   

  

**Asset Performance \& Strategy**
* Lead the development and execution of asset strategies to enhance asset value and returns.
* Monitor financial and operational KPIs of the hospitality portfolio.
* Analyse monthly and quarterly performance reports from hotel operators and provide insights to leadership.
* Benchmark performance against market data and competitive set.


**Operator Management**
* Act as the key liaison between Shamal and hotel operators, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Review annual budgets, business plans, marketing plans, and capital expenditure plans.
* Ensure compliance with management agreements, brand standards, and operating covenants.


**Financial \& Investment Analysis**
* Perform financial modelling, scenario analysis, and valuation of existing and potential assets.
* Assist in the underwriting of new hospitality investments and developments.
* Work closely with finance and investment teams to support strategic initiatives.
* Evaluate and assess annual budgets and projections.


**Capital Planning \& Project Oversight**
* Oversee capital expenditure projects and renovations to ensure timelines and budgets are met.
* Support in repositioning or rebranding strategies to improve asset performance.


**Project Management and Committee approvals**
* Oversee all capital expenditure projects for approval.
* Upon approval, manage their completion to ensure adherence to the allocated budget.


**Reporting \& Governance**
* Prepare and present asset performance reports to senior management and stakeholders.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, risk, and compliance frameworks.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as hospitality, strategy, finance, or business administration is required.
* Certification in hospitality analytics, real estate or asset management.
* 8\-10 years of experience in hospitality, F\&B, asset management, hotel consulting, investment, or related fields.
* Strong knowledge of hotel operations, P\&L analysis, contract negotiation, and operator management.


**For more information about Shamal, please visit our LinkedIn page**

data.jd_text:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Director, Business Development, Corporate Solutions \- B2B Acceptance
   

  

**Overview**
 This role sits within Corporate Solutions and is responsible for developing and scaling Mastercard’s B2B Acceptance strategy across East \+ West Arabia and Eastern Europe. You will help acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants unlock new commercial payment flows.
   

  

 B2B Acceptance is a significant growth opportunity. Corporate buyers increasingly want to pay suppliers using commercial and virtual cards, particularly for invoice\-based payments. For acquirers and merchants, this creates an opportunity to capture new high\-value flows, improve cash flow, reduce manual processes and enable better reconciliation through data and straight\-through processing.
   

  

 Key questions
   

  

* Do you have a track record of building and scaling commercial payment products or acceptance\-led growth strategies?
* Can you influence senior executives across banks, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and large merchants?
* Are you motivated by solving commercial and operational problems through technology, data and partnerships?
* Can you turn market trends into execution plans that drive GDV, revenue and merchant activation?


 Role
   

  

* Develop and execute the EEMEA B2B Acceptance strategy to retain, grow and expand Mastercard’s commercial acceptance footprint.
* Drive incremental commercial volume and revenue by enabling acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and merchants to capture high\-value B2B and invoice\-based payment flows.
* Remove operational barriers to B2B acceptance, including onboarding friction, manual processing, reconciliation challenges, supplier education and acceptance visibility.
* Build and scale market strategies for virtual card acceptance, supplier enablement, straight\-through processing and automated reconciliation.
* Provide thought leadership to global product teams on B2B merchant, acquiring, fintech, PSP, AP/AR, ERP and embedded finance opportunities.
* Lead digital presence, market insights, research and sales enablement for Commercial Acceptance across Eastern Europe and the Middle East.
* Build educational collateral and go\-to\-market playbooks to support banks, acquirers, fintechs, merchants and internal teams.
* Partner with Commercial Solutions, issuers, acquirers, PSPs, fintechs and account teams to activate commercial acceptance assets and partnerships.
* Manage dashboards and KPIs covering merchant activation, supplier enablement, GDV, net revenue, pipeline conversion and partner performance.
* Ensure Mastercard resources are deployed effectively to support commercial outcomes, market priorities and scalable regional growth.


**All About You**
* Strong understanding of acquiring, merchant economics, commercial card acceptance, virtual cards and B2B payment flows.
* Proven ability to build and scale product value propositions, particularly across acquiring, merchant or supplier enablement.
* Experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, ERP, procurement, embedded finance or invoice\-based payments is a strong advantage.
* Strong commercial mindset, with experience managing revenue growth, pipeline execution, business performance or P\&L\-related outcomes.
* Executive presence and consultative sales experience, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally.
* Strong analytical capability, including the ability to use data to build business cases, track performance and shape strategy.
* Collaborative, entrepreneurial and execution\-focused, with the ability to work across a matrixed organization and turn strategy into measurable outcomes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**About The Role**
 The PMO Manager is responsible for overseeing and optimizing project management activities across multiple streams to ensure the successful delivery of projects. This role involves supporting Project Managers (PMs), managing knowledge bases, ensuring the execution of Hypercare activities, and identifying and resolving risks and dependencies. The PMO Manager plays a key role in promoting cross\-stream alignment, implementing communication and escalation plans, and providing guidance to the project management team to achieve organizational goals.
   

  

**As a part of your job, you will:**
* Knowledge Management: Responsible for maintaining and organizing the project knowledge base, ensuring that all relevant project documentation is up to date and accessible.
* Support PMs in KPIs: Assist Project Managers in updating and tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to ensure projects are aligned with organizational goals and performance metrics.
* Hypercare Activities: Lead and manage Hypercare activities, ensuring that projects transition smoothly from development to production and all post\-launch issues are addressed in a timely manner.
* Risk \& Issue Management: Collaborate with PMs to identify, assess, and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies, ensuring projects remain on track and within scope.
* Promote Cross\-Stream Alignment: Foster strong communication and alignment between different project streams and teams, ensuring efficient collaboration and minimizing conflicts or misunderstandings.
* Communication \& Escalation Plans: Design, implement, and manage comprehensive communication and escalation plans to ensure timely updates and issue resolution across all levels of the project.
* Escalation to PMO Director: Escalate any critical project risks, issues, or delays to the PMO Director, providing them with necessary insights and support to make informed decisions.
* Coaching \& Mentoring: Provide guidance and mentorship to Project Managers, helping to build their skills and ensure adherence to best practices and processes.
* Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors, ensuring they meet project requirements, timelines, and quality standards. Collaborate with vendors to address any performance issues and ensure smooth project delivery.


**What are we looking for?**
**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. PMP, PRINCE2, or similar project management certifications are highly desirable.

* Ability to communicate complex information effectively to stakeholders at all levels.
* Leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to guide and develop project managers.
* Proficient in project management software and tools (e.g., MS Project, Jira, Asana, etc.).
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**Personal traits**

* Teamwork skills but also a sense of autonomy;

**Overview**
 This is a critical Transformation role responsible for enabling the delivery of the multi\-year transformation agenda. This agenda is key to delivering long\-term sustainable growth (NOPBT margin ambition) for the OU/market and building organization capability for the future.
   

  

 The main pillars of the Transformation function are:
   

  

* Next Chapter Operating Model: Next Chapter organization, GCC, Processes, Simplification, WoW
* Cost Transformation: 2\-3 year productivity pipeline
* Transformation Management Office: develop and maintain integrated business transformation agenda which aligns to the OU/market vision and strategic KPIs
* Lead several key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives: as aligned with senior stakeholders
* Change Management


**Responsibilities**
* Operating Model
* Next Chapter Operating Model:
* Provide Program leadership to Next Chapter for OU/market. Working with OU Next Chapter PMO and CMO, and Region team, to land Next Chapter organization, processes and ways of working, per aligned OU roadmap
* Drive program level visibility and progress, connect the key workstreams.
* GCC:
* Provide program leadership to the OU/market GCC agenda per aligned roadmap: Ensure smooth transition through leveraging global scale and consolidating similar works in HUBs to maximize effectiveness.
* Collaborate with multiple partners in OU/market (Function Leads, People Lead, Comms Lead) and Region GCC team to ensure transition moves according to plan.
* Drive program\-level visibility and progress. Embed overall change management and communications. Manage interdependencies and key risks, escalating as required
* Cost Transformation
* Provide Program management to the OU/market Cost Transformation agenda. Provide program leadership to the OU/market cost agenda, focused on building a medium and long\-term productivity pipeline (next 2\-5 years).
* Drive program level visibility and progress, visibility of pipeline, connect and operationalize the key x\-functional workstreams, working with key stakeholders to size opportunities, mobilize team, build roadmaps/scorecards:
* DTV, Portfolio Harmonization, SC transformation, Procurement, GTM, A\&M, Operating Model (Picasso/Next Chapter/GCC), Digital
* Act as the Lead for Saudi DTV: Key tasks include Sprint Facilitation, Prioritization, \& Planning, SWAT Team Identification \& Onboarding, Value Realization and Brainstorming Ideas based on Benchmarking
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* TMO support to cost transformation governance processes (e.g. Productivity Council, agenda, pre\-reads, and actions as appropriate for OU/market).
* Manage interdependencies of workstreams and key risks, escalating as required.
* Transformation Management Office
* Own delivery of multi\-year OU/market Transformation roadmap, including digital agenda, working in conjunction with key OU stakeholders, Region Transformation and Deployment teams.
* Define overall project management plan leveraging standard frameworks for each program with the Project/Program lead, delivering detailed roadmaps and key milestones
* Define best support for each initiative in conjunction with key stakeholders and identify cross\-functional integration and tension points.
* Provide leadership and governance to these projects, working closely with core project teams, Functions, and OUs as required.
* Leverage project management methodology, guidance, and communication frameworks
* Provide scorecard and performance metrics for each project, manage risk and course correcting as required, and deliver defined benefits.
* Embed overall change management and communications.
* Lead process by prioritizing all investment requests, tracking resources, enabling active risk management, and ensuring value realization.
* Define a multi\-year investment plan and work with project stakeholders to outline the scope, goals, deliverables, required resources, budget \& timing.
* Build tools and capability to support OU/market Transformation agenda: Partner with Sector TMO and CMO to build standard tools, project management, and working methods to ensure execution discipline across our transformation and strategic projects.
* Collaborate with the Global Team to leverage global tools and capabilities and get insights from other sectors on adoption and roll\-out practices.
* Lead key scale x\-functional transformation initiatives (to be aligned with stakeholders)
* Provide leadership and project management to several scale OU/market Transformation projects
* Change Management
* Lead the change management community, plan training for new change leads and impacted managers, and drive effective organizational implementation.
* Working with EMEA Change Lead to seamlessly integrate a clear change management plan.
* Sharing learnings across projects and teams
* Estimate 2\-3 significant projects per year (often multiyear projects)


**Qualifications**
 Key Skills/Experience Required
   

  

* University degree or MBA
* 10\+ years of business experience in leadership roles at Market/OU/Region/Global level in the FMCG sector, preferably with transformation, change management and/or project management experience
* Deep understanding of the OU/market, processes, priorities and goals


 Key skills required for the role:
   

  

* Thinking: Excellent strategic mindset and thinking skills, forward\-thinking, ability to think holistically E2E and connect the dots, ability to frame the right questions and develop frameworks and solutions to solve complex problems. Highly analytical, motivated, decisive thought leader with excellent general management skills – strong bias for action and can\-do approach to work, “out of the box” thinking using traditional and non\-traditional information sources to support recommendations and drive business results.
* Execution: Strong leadership skills and proven track record of partnering with and influencing at all levels of the organization to develop and implement scale transformation or strategic initiatives, working across business functions to set and execute the agenda. Outstanding project management skills and ability to bring clarity and discipline to the transformation agenda. Excellent communication skills and ability to simplify.
* Relationships: collaborative team player who thrives working in an agile and ambiguous environment, demonstrating solid people skills, working well x\-function and x\-BU to align behind goals and delivery
* Agility: flexibility and willingness to take on diverse and challenging tasks, passion for supporting and managing change. Ability to operate in through ambiguity and adapt to changing priorities. Demonstrates courage and conviction required to lead scale changes initiatives and embrace new ways of working.

**Description**

To ensure strict adherence to the scope of work detailed in the terms and conditions of the contract under the individual’s management. Ensure that strict cost control systems are established in all departments in the operation, and that they are constantly maintained and monitored. To ensure that storage and stock control systems are maintained up to date, and to monitor stock rotation and validity. To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Duties**
* To ensure that the contract is operated within the budgetary margins established for the operation.
* To maintain constant liaison with the Client representative for the individual’s operation and establish a good working relationship.
* To monitor ordering of all supplies/requirements both internally on site and from the supplier.
* To ensure that validity of all employee documentation, e.g. security passes, medical certificates, licenses, vacations where applicable, are maintained and that timely action is taken for renewal that will not adversely affect the individual’s operation.
* To ensure employee time sheets are correctly filled in and that they are forwarded to Head Office on time each month.
* To liaise with Training Department for Staff Trainings.
* To conduct job training on the individual’s operations.
* To carry out annual evaluations of staff. Make recommendations for employee promotions, salary changes, employee of the month, disciplinary action, including termination where applicable.
* To ensure that employees are aware of the company policies and procedures and to ensure compliance.
* To ensure that the individual is aware of the contents of the KSA labor Law, and its stipulations regarding disciplinary action in particular.
* To ensure that leave schedules are maintained, and that requests for relievers are submitted to CEO at least two months in advance.
* To ensure strict confidentiality of all company financial information regardless of its nature.
* To compile and submit to CEO monthly reports on all aspects of the operations that should highlight any problems encountered and actions taken to rectify them.
* This report should cover maintenance activities, including both planned and reactive tasks, which are completed within required timeframes, on\-going or new projects information, supplier communications and enhancement schemes for the cost\-effective management of services.
* To ensure that copies of all Client correspondence, minutes of site meetings and any other communication (verbal or written) pertained to the operation are transmitted to the CEO immediately upon acknowledgment.
* The CEO must review on all offers to the Client prior to submittal. Site Engineers, where applicable, must be involved in offers pertaining to anything within the individual’s discipline.
* To ensure that company and Client owned assets and equipment are maintained in good order, and that repair/replenishment costs are strictly controlled. CEO must be informed of any major R\&M activity.
* To ensure that highest standards of health, hygiene and safety are maintained in the individual’s operation and to liaise closely with the company’s CEO on these matters.

* Workstream Integration: Synchronize multi\-disciplinary workstreams—including infrastructure, sustainability, landscape architecture, and transport planning—to ensure a unified project output.
* Revenue Management \& Performance Monitoring: Implement and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) regarding schedule adherence, budget burn rates, and technical quality standards.
* Governance \& Change Control
* Project Reporting \& Performance Management: Lead the preparation and delivery of high\-quality weekly and monthly progress reports (MPRs) for clients, providing clear updates on programme status, key milestones, risks, resource utilisation, commercial performance, and upcoming look\-ahead activities.
* Scope Management: Rigorously monitor project boundaries; identify, document, and manage "scope creep" to ensure commercial viability.
* Change Protocol: Execute formal Change Requests for variations in schedule or budget, conducting impact assessments before escalating for Senior Management approval.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (regulatory, environmental, or financial) and develop robust mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central liaison for clients, government authorities, utility providers, and contractors, ensuring transparency and trust.
* Conflict Resolution: Mediate technical or contractual disputes between stakeholders, leveraging professional diplomacy to maintain project momentum.
* Reporting Excellence: Author and present comprehensive monthly progress reports, dashboard updates, and executive briefings for internal leadership and external client boards.
* Quality Assurance \& Documentation
* Technical Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with local planning regulations, international best practices, and the specific sustainability mandates of the project – by working with the technical leads of the project.
* Document Control: Oversee a rigorous documentation environment, ensuring all deliverables, data requests, email requests and stakeholder approvals are audited and archived correctly.
* Schedule Management: Develop and maintain detailed Project Plans using MS Project or Primavera P6\. Utilize Critical Path Methodology (CPM) to identify and mitigate potential delays.


**Qualifications**
* Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Management or Information Technology.
* Professional Experience: A minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in project management for management consultancies or similar. Experience of project management within large\-scale master planning or urban infrastructure is desired.
* Project Methodology: Advanced proficiency in structured frameworks such as PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile, or Waterfall.
* Software Command: Expert\-level mastery of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel and Word. Primavera P6 is desirable.
+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.
+ Data/Commercial: Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, financial modelling)

* Essential Behavioural Competencies
* Self\-Starter \& Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, thinks ahead, identifies risks and opportunities early, and drives actions forward without the need for close supervision or constant direction.
* Workload Management \& Accountability: Effectively manages own priorities, remains organised under pressure, and can independently balance multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal guidance.
* Team Contribution \& Support: Works collaboratively as part of the wider team, builds strong internal relationships, and actively supports colleagues by sharing workload and contributing where needed.
* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.
* Specialized Knowledge: Experience with KSA Giga\-projects is a significant advantage.
* Advanced Analytics: Use of Power BI and other analytical tools.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**Job Title**

 Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 Ready to engineer your positive impact? Then join Tractebel, part of the ENGIE Group, and our passionate experts around the globe, driven by shaping a more sustainable world every day.  Are you ready to make a difference? Then we look forward to meeting you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Tractebel is more than a place to work. It’s an opportunity to evolve alongside industry experts on impactful infrastructure projects.
* We actively support the development of our people, with growth opportunities across the ENGIE Group.
* We offer a competitive salary package including paid holidays, performance\-based bonuses (for eligible roles), comprehensive health insurance, and additional employee benefits.
* Flexible and collaborative working environments that encourage innovation and teamwork.
* A culture that values diversity, sustainability, ethics, and safety.


**Your Mission**
 As
 **Program Director – Civil Engineering** 
 in our Infrastructure department, you will contribute to our mission every day by leading and overseeing complex civil engineering and infrastructure programs across the region. You will play a critical role in driving strategic program delivery, ensuring operational excellence, managing multidisciplinary teams, and developing sustainable infrastructure solutions that create long\-term value for clients and communities.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute the program’s strategic vision, goals, and objectives in alignment with the company’s business strategy.
* Lead and manage multidisciplinary engineering and project teams to ensure successful delivery of infrastructure projects.
* Oversee the planning, design, and implementation of civil engineering initiatives while ensuring compliance with quality, budget, and schedule requirements.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to assess project risks and implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, regulatory authorities, consultants, and key stakeholders.
* Monitor program performance through defined KPIs, milestones, and reporting mechanisms to ensure project success.
* Identify opportunities for business growth, market expansion, and diversification within the civil engineering and infrastructure sector.


**We Would Love to Hear from People With**
**Your Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
* Master’s degree or professional certifications in Project Management are preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of experience in senior leadership roles within the civil engineering and infrastructure industry.
* Extensive experience in program management and large\-scale infrastructure project delivery.
* Strong technical expertise in infrastructure projects including bridges, tunnels, roads, stormwater drainage systems, rainwater channels, and city development programs.
* Experience working with well\-known consulting firms or government authorities.
* Strong knowledge of civil engineering principles, construction methodologies, and project management best practices.
* Proven experience in strategic planning, budget management, and business development.
* Proficiency in project management tools, reporting systems, and data analysis software.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management certification is preferred.
* Professional proficiency in English is required; Arabic language skills are preferred.


**Who You Are**

* You are a strategic thinker with strong leadership and decision\-making capabilities.
* You have excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* You are capable of leading multidisciplinary teams in complex project environments.
* You have strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* You are highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* You are committed to safety, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
* You have the ability to build long\-term client relationships and drive business growth.


**Who We Are**

The driving force behind reaching these goals is our greatest asset: our people. Diversity leads to fresh perspectives that drive performance and innovation.

**Gold And Minerals Joint Stock Company**
 Gold and Minerals is a leading exploration and development company specializing in gold and base metal projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. With a strong focus on sustainable and responsible mining practices, the company is committed to unlocking the Kingdom’s rich mineral potential while contributing to its economic growth.
   

  

 The company has a proven track record in discovering and developing high\-quality mineral resources, highlighted by the success of its flagship
 **Jabal Qutman Gold** 
 ,
 **Wadi Bidah Copper\-Gold and Ajlan JV** 
 projects, positioning it as one of the key players in Saudi Arabia’s growing mining sector. In response to the Kingdom’s strategic initiatives to expand the mining industry, Gold and Minerals is actively expanding its team to support its ambitious exploration and development programs.
   

  

 Our team consists of highly skilled, multinational geologists and mining professionals working collaboratively across resource expansion, project development, and greenfield exploration projects. We foster a dynamic, innovative, and safety\-focused work environment that encourages professional growth, knowledge sharing, and career advancement.
   

  

 At Gold and Minerals , we are passionate about creating value for our stakeholders while maintaining the highest standards of environmental stewardship and community engagement.
   

  

 Joining our team means being part of a forward\-thinking organization that is shaping the future of mining in Saudi Arabia.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Responsible for providing strategic leadership, direction, and oversight of the newly formed joint venture. Ensures execution of shareholders’ joint exploration, resource definition, project development, and assessment through to mining strategy and operational mine site. Drives value creation by ensuring safe business operations, efficient implementation, innovation, team development, adherence to timelines, and reporting requirements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deliver the JV’s work program as committed to MIM.
* Develop and execute work programs aligned with project requirements and exploration results to meet timelines.
* Manage operational functions and ensure delivery of approved plans.
* Assess and optimize future mining projects.
* Ensure safe operations across exploration, project definition, construction, and mining activities.
* Manage costs within approved budgets.
* Ensure timely and accurate reporting to shareholders and MIM.
* Maintain strong governance standards, including procurement compliance.
* Lead and develop high\-performing leadership teams and promote a strong safety culture.
* Ensure compliance with legal, environmental, and regulatory requirements, including mining license applications.
* Represent both shareholders’ interests within the joint venture.
* Ensure effective engagement with local communities and stakeholders.


**Key Work Interactions**
 Internal Relationships
   

  

* Joint Venture Technical Committee
* Shareholders
* Employees
* Site General Managers and Operations
* Shareholder financial teams


 External Relationships
   

  

* Communities
* Government agencies and regulatory bodies
* Consultants and engineering firms
* Equipment and technology suppliers
* Adjacent license holders
* Contractors and service providers


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, Mineral Processing, or related field
* Project Management Professional (PMP) and/or Health \& Safety certification is desirable
* Valid driving licence in KSA or convertible to KSA licence


**Experience**
* Minimum 15 years of experience in the mining industry, with at least 10 years in senior leadership roles
* Proven track record in managing advanced exploration projects and delivering feasibility studies
* Experience in coordinating multidisciplinary teams and transitioning projects from exploration to development and operations
* Experience in establishing new projects, including policy development, training, and HSE procedures
* Strong understanding of structurally controlled gold deposits, open pit mining, and precious metal processing
* Culturally adept and delivery\-focused
* Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and communication skills


**Work Schedule**
 This role operates on a FIFO roster in a remote operational location, following a 6 weeks on / 3 weeks off rotation schedule.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Director will provide overall leadership and strategic direction for PMCM services on roads and bridges projects, acting as the primary point of accountability for project performance and client satisfaction. The role will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and ensuring that all project objectives are achieved in line with contractual obligations and corporate standards.
   

  

 Subject to project award, the successful candidate will lead project planning, mobilization, execution, and close\-out activities, while establishing robust governance, reporting, risk management, and stakeholder coordination processes. They will oversee project controls, construction supervision interfaces, consultant and contractor performance, and ensure compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory requirements.
   

  

 The Project Director will also be expected to maintain strong relationships with clients, government authorities, contractors, and key stakeholders, while supporting business growth through opportunity identification, bid support, and strategic client engagement where required.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and direct PMCM delivery for major roads and bridges projects from inception through completion, subject to award.
* Serve as the senior client interface and ensure effective stakeholder management at all levels.
* Provide leadership to project managers, discipline leads, construction management teams, and support functions.
* Establish and monitor project delivery strategies, execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
* Ensure effective management of scope, risk, change control, quality, HSE, and commercial performance.
* Oversee design coordination, construction supervision, contract administration, and project controls functions.
* Drive timely decision\-making and resolution of technical, contractual, and operational issues.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, local regulations, and company procedures.
* Prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, dashboards, and performance updates.
* Support recruitment, mentoring, and development of project team members.
* Contribute to bid preparation, technical proposals, and strategic positioning for future PMCM opportunities.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a highly experienced infrastructure leader with a strong track record of delivering large, complex roads and bridges projects under PMCM or similar consultancy\-led delivery models. They will possess excellent leadership, communication, commercial, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate effectively in demanding, high\-profile project environments.
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Minimum 20 years of relevant professional experience in infrastructure project delivery, with a strong emphasis on site\-based execution and project delivery leadership for major roads and bridges projects.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience in managing projects through key delivery stages, including mobilization, construction supervision, interface management, testing and commissioning, project close\-out, and handover.
* Proven track record in leading the day\-to\-day delivery of large\-scale infrastructure projects, ensuring performance against programme, budget, quality, and contractual obligations.
* Strong practical experience in construction management, site operations, contractor oversight, supervision teams, and resolution of on\-site technical and operational issues.
* Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary site teams and coordinate effectively across contractors, designers, client representatives, authorities, and other project stakeholders.
* GCC experience is mandatory.
* KSA experience is a strong advantage.
* Chartered Engineer status is preferred or equivalent recognized professional accreditation.
* Strong knowledge of SHEQ principles, standards, and implementation practices across major infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated commitment to Safety, Health, Environment, and Quality leadership, with the ability to embed a strong SHEQ culture across project teams and supply chain partners.
* Proven experience in promoting safe working practices, quality compliance, risk mitigation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement throughout project delivery.
* Strong understanding of contract administration, construction management, project controls, change management, and stakeholder coordination in live project environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong client\-facing presence and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders and public\-sector entities.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you ready to shape the learning architecture of our digitally native airline and its workforce?
   

  

 We are seeking a visionary and commercially astute Director of Talent Development to lead our enterprise\-wide Learning \& Development strategy thereby building a future ready, safety centered and high\-performing organisation.
   

  

 Yours is a role responsible for building a future\-ready workforce that strengthens safety, performance, and long\-term growth. You are expected to oversee high\-impact learning delivery using blended, digital, simulation\-based, and experiential methods tailored to aviation.
   

  

 Partnering closely with senior leaders, you will ensure leadership depth, regulatory compliance, and workforce readiness across all functions.
   

  

 Importantly, your remit includes integrating leadership development, safety/compliance learning, operational training, and digital capability building into a unified enterprise framework. Further, you will design and implement a fully integrated airline learning ecosystem spanning safety, regulatory, operational, leadership, and digital capabilities.
   

  

 Central to your success in this role is the ability to own and manage the Talent Development budget, ensuring strategic ROI. Moreover, you will t rack and report KPIs including bench strength, capability readiness, and program effectiveness.
   

  

 You will also ensure regulatory alignment with key aviation bodies including the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Air Transport Association (IATA) and the General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), integrating compliance requirements into enterprise learning frameworks and operational governance.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building future\-ready leaders, strengthening safety culture, and shaping capability at scale, we invite you to lead the next chapter of our talent journey.
   

  

**About You**
 Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 10 years of sound leadership experience within an L\&D or Talent Development capacity interpreting strategy and policy in order to set and deliver objectives within the medium to long term.
   

  

 We’d love to hear from you even more if you are a bilingual Saudi national with proven leadership experience.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.
