data.jd_text:
**Department:** 
 NUQ Library
   

  

 Northwestern University in Qatar (NU\-Q) seeks an outstanding Director of the NU\-Q Library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library guides a team of library professionals with vision and purpose in support of NU\-Q vision of excellence in teaching, research, and mediamaking. Reporting to the Associate Dean for Education, the Director of the NU\-Q Library will provide collaborative leadership and strategic direction to the programs, services, initiatives, and collections of the NU\-Q Library. The successful candidate will be a forward\-thinking professional who is enthusiastic about advancing research, teaching, learning, and practice through access to NU\-Q Library resources, and knowledgeable about the complex nature of building, supervising, managing, and mentoring a collaborative team. The Director of the NU\-Q Library will facilitate partnerships in education and knowledge creation within Northwestern and beyond.
   

  

**Core Mission**
* Commitment to the core mission of NU\-Q as a global community of evidence\-based storytellers guided by the core values of excellence, collaboration, community, and sustainability
* Leadership and Strategic Vision
* Administration and Supervision
* Campus Engagement
* Professional and Ethical Practices and Innovation
* Assessment and Continuous Improvement


 The NU\-Q Library is a user\-focused library and serves the research and educational needs of NU\-Q faculty, staff, and students. The growing collection is made up of print, DVD/Blu\-ray, and electronic resources purchased and provided to support the curricular needs of the Communication Program which offers Media Industries and Technology major, the Journalism and Strategic Communication Program which offers Journalism major, and the Liberal Arts Program. The NU\-Q Library’s core mission is to coordinate and deliver robust reference services both in\-person and online, supporting research and learning across disciplines.
   

  

 The Director of the NU\-Q Library supports the university leadership and is responsible for the overall management and administration of the NU\-Q library. The Director of the NU\-Q Library oversees all aspects of NU\-Q Library staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment. With a keen eye on strategic planning and strategic resource management, the Director of the NU\-Q Library develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence. As a passionate advocate for the NU\-Q Library's core mission and services, the Director of the NU\-Q Library builds strong relationships with campus leadership and stakeholders, championing the library's essential role in academic excellence and student success. Through thoughtful planning and continuous assessment, the Director of the NU\-Q Library drives the development of innovative research support services and information resources. By partnering with faculty, academic departments, and student support teams, the Director of the NU\-Q Library helps elevate community members’ learning outcomes and ensures the library remains a vital, evolving hub of intellectual engagement. The Director of the NU\-Q Library fosters a culture of shared governance; advances the library culture of assessment through data collection; engages in evidence\-based decision\-making practices; and promotes a culture of accessibility, accountability, innovation, and ethical practices.
   

  

 There are also opportunities to collaborate with NU\-Q’s Institute for Advanced Study of the Global South (IAS), Artificial Intelligence and Media Lab (AIM\-Lab), and Media Majlis Museum (MMM). The IAS in the Global South at NU\-Q (\#IAS\_NUQ) produces and promotes evidence\-based storytelling focused on the histories, cultures, societies, and media of the Global South. The AIM\-LAB at NU\-Q produces and promotes data\-based storytelling focused on the intersection of artificial intelligence and media. MMM at NU\-Q is a museum dedicated to exploring journalism, communication, media and art.
   

  

 In the era of digital technologies and AI, libraries in media schools need to transition from a conventional resource center into an active catalyst for digital storytelling, research advancement, and ethical media innovation. They curate and provide access to multimedia collections, data journalism resources, AI\-driven production tools, and cutting\-edge media technologies. Beyond access, libraries in media schools are expected to cultivate advanced information literacy, AI literacy, critical understanding of algorithms, copyright compliance, academic integrity, and responsible AI integration in creative projects. They partner with faculty, staff, and students to confront misinformation, deepfakes, and data ethics challenges while upholding the highest standards of media research, media production, journalism practice, and creative scholarship.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ph.D. in a subject area relevant to the core mission of Northwestern University in Qatar (communication studies, media studies, media design, cinema studies, journalism studies, liberal arts, etc.)


**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) from an ALA\-accredited program.
* Minimum of 6 years of successful progressive leadership experience in university libraries (e.g., Assistant Director of Library and then Associate Director of Library required to support the Director of Library).
* Proven experience in and strong record of supervising, training, mentoring, and evaluating librarian faculty and staff members, fostering professional growth, contribution, and collaboration
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing and delivering library faculty/staff development programs
* Proven experience in and strong record of annual assessment of library services and implementation of long\-term strategies for the growth and innovation of library services
* Proven experience in and strong record of data collection and data analytics to inform evidence\-based decision\-making and service improvements
* Proven experience in and strong record of assessment of the effectiveness of library services, spaces, and collections in advancing student success and academic excellence
* Proven experience in and strong record of adoption of emerging technologies and innovative practices to enhance access, discovery, and research support
* Proven experience in and strong record of development and implementation of strategic initiatives that support institutional goals and accreditation requirements
* Proven experience in and strong record of university teaching and instructional design for information literacy
* Proven experience in and strong record of developing programs that showcase the role of university libraries in research, curricular use, and community engagement
* Proven experience in strategic planning, assessment practices, and advocacy in higher education environments.
* Proven experience in and strong record of building and maintaining effective partnerships and collaborations between the library, university leadership, academic departments, and the broader university community
* Proven experience in and strong record of dedication to student success
* Solid understanding of the organizational structure, organizational workflows, and approval chains in top\-tier universities
* Extensive knowledge of a broad range of issues and emerging trends in managing, collecting, and providing access to academic/university libraries
* Knowledge of Open Education Resources (OER) and affordable learning initiatives
* Comprehensive familiarity with the current trends in academic libraries, media schools, digital scholarship, and student learning support.
* Proven experience in budget and grant development and management
* Excellent communication, collaborative, interpersonal, and organizational skills
* Strong record of professional engagement and contribution, such as research, publications, and involvement in professional and scholarly organizations
* Strong record of progressively responsible experience working with a multidisciplinary team in academic/university libraries, including supervisory and leadership roles.
* Proven experience in and strong interest in applying new and emerging technologies to Library collections and archives, including digital scholarship and digital humanities initiatives
* Ability to demonstrate a calm, courteous, and professional demeanor when working with a variety of situations and/or people.
* Vision for leveraging emerging technologies, including the ethical application and use of artificial intelligence for library resources, services, and assessment
* Experience with collection development and maintenance, including databases and resources


***Please note this position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.***
**Responsibilities**
* Provide leadership to and management of a forward\-thinking NU\-Q Library, by playing a dynamic leadership role, guiding a team of library professionals with vision and purpose
* Oversee all aspects of staffing\-from recruitment and onboarding to performance evaluation and professional growth\-while fostering a collaborative work environment
* With a keen eye on strategic resource management, the Director develops and administers departmental budgets to ensure operational excellence.
* Articulate a compelling vision for the NU\-Q Library and the value of the NU\-Q Library in supporting research, teaching, learning, and community engagement that aligns with the NU\-Q Library’s core mission and strategic directions
* Provide vision for NU\-Q Library collection development and stewardship. Establish priorities and develop policies that guide the development of library collections in alignment with the core mission of NU\-Q
* Establish strategic directions and priorities for a range of user\-centered services and programs that create exceptional experiences for the Northwestern community in support of their research, teaching, learning and practice with NU\-Q Library resources
* Provide leadership and oversight to the development of staff development programs and initiatives that establish the NU\-Q Library as a dynamic and innovative teaching and learning resource at Northwestern
* Provide overall direction for a team of 7 librarian faculty and staff members. Directly supervise Library faculty/staff members including librarians, library associate, and library assistants. Coordinate the department work. Provide mentorship, advocacy and support to all department staff and foster their professional engagement and growth
* Build and nurture collaborations and partnerships within the library, with faculty, academic departments, and the broader Northwestern community that strengthen and promote the key role and core mission of the NU\-Q Library in research, teaching, and community engagement
* Collaborate with library departments to advance the library’s digital transformation agenda to broaden discovery, access, and preservation of primary source materials in support of research and academic pursuits
* Represent the NU\-Q library in initiatives and events related to the strategic vision and priorities of the university within and outside NU\-Q. Contribute to the library’s leadership role in the field through projects, presentations, scholarship, and active participation in relevant professional organizations


**The anticipated salary range is $100,000 – $110,000 Commensurate with experience and qualifications.** 
 The pay offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on factors including (but not limited to) the experience and qualifications of the selected candidate including years since terminal degree, training, and field or discipline; departmental budget availability; internal comparators; and external market pay for comparable jobs.
   

  

 NU\-Q is a community of evidence\-based storytellers in the Global South. We are a globally embedded institution, being one of three campuses of Northwestern University (Chicago, Doha, Evanston) and one of several partner universities in the Qatar Foundation’s Education City in Doha, Qatar. Our mission is to mentor and educate students to become creative, ethical, and impactful communicators across cultural and national boundaries. We are committed to a vibrant student life, academic excellence, and high\-level undergraduate student research and media making, particularly on the Global South. Located at the confluence of continents, NU\-Q is a multidisciplinary global community with approximately 500 students from 60 countries.
   

  

 NU\-Q provides competitive compensation and benefits. The medium of instruction is English, but proficiency in Arabic or another regional language is an advantage at NU\-Q. Candidates with experience in US higher education as well as in the Arab region are particularly encouraged to apply. Northwestern University in Qatar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

* Balance customer satisfaction with operational efficiency and financial sustainability.


**Drive Data\-Informed CX Decisions**
* Define and track core CX metrics (defect rates, cancellations, delays, ratings).

**Job Description**
 Wood is accepting expressions of interest for a Project Manager (Offshore) to join our team in Qatar. This is a key role within the Wood Doha office delivering across study, FEED, EPC and PMC scopes of work.  Reflecting The Market Focus For The Office In Both Brownfield And Greenfield Opportunities, Multi\-skilled Personnel Are Sought, In Particular Those With Experience In
   

  

* Onshore Oil and Gas
* Offshore Oil and Gas


**Responsibilities**
* Champions both Wood and client Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality cultures. Leads by example in ‘raising the shield’, demonstrating the ‘courage to intervene’. Ensures that procedures are followed and that a high standard of safety and quality is achieved in all associated work.
* Plan, direct, co\-ordinate, and control the work
* Execute Projects in accordance with corporate practices and Project procedures
* Developing and implementing a project execution plan and project schedules that meets with Company and Contract requirements
* Provide leadership and commitment to the Project HSSE and Quality plan
* Keeping to the control budget within the objectives established for the Project
* To focus upon customer care and customer feedback
* To understand the Project ‘business case’ and drivers
* Act as focal point for Engineering, Procurement, and Project services resources deployed on the project
* Interface closely with client management representatives to ensure client interests are being accommodated
* Clearly define and communicate the project objectives and organization to the Project team
* To feedback to the Company data related to performance of work on a regular basis
* To monitor and expedite account receivables for the Project
* To document lessons learned and to review/implement lessons learned from other Projects
* To close out the project


**Qualifications**
* Undergraduate degree in an engineering discipline
* Minimum of 15\-20 years of relevant experience
* Ideally candidates will have further education and certification in the field of Project Management, PMP or APM for example
* Must have good working experience of the Microsoft Office applications in the development of documents, presentations, trackers and schedules etc
* Is a self\-motivated, proactive and highly driven individual with high standards, attention to detail and capable of demonstrating initiative
* High level of commercial aptitude and awareness. Should be able to interpret and follow the Contract whilst raising potential delays, change and commercial matters to Project Sponsors in good time
* Must be an excellent communicator, being a leader in the success of multi\-discipline team delivery. Motivates teams in a positive manner to ensure a proactive approach in the delivery of timely solutions
* Highly experienced with risk and change management across the full project lifecycle, ideally having exposure to both design and site works. Highlights and quantifies change when it impacts the work
* Experienced across multiple project phases such as Concept/Feasibility, Pre\-FEED, FEED, Detailed Design, Procurement, Construction, Commissioning, Star\-Up and Warrantee
* Proven experience in managing lump sum contract for Engineering projects for oil and gas industry (Qatar experience is preferred)
* Able to lead others in a challenging environment
* Able to make decisions and drive decision processes
* Excellent analytical and abstract reasoning skills, plus excellent organization skills
* Well\-developed management and administrative skills
* Works within a team to establish direction, alignment and commitment
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills. Ability to get along with diverse personalities. Tactful, mature, and flexible
* High energy level, comfortable performing multifaceted projects
* Demonstrated servant leadership ability, team management, and interpersonal skills
* Well organized, credible and decisive


**Applicants Are Required To**
* Confidently deliver assigned scopes of work independently / remotely from management whilst leading others, with minimal guidance and direction
* Take ownership of scopes of work, coordinating the engineering disciplines and supporting functions to deliver successful outcomes
* Have demonstrable experience of working independently / remotely from technical leadership personnel (although functional leadership will be within the Doha office).
* Have demonstrable experience of working within a small project office, supporting cross discipline activities beyond their core discipline
* Be willing and able to represent Wood in both onshore and offshore surveys, holding relevant certification or willing to undertake suitable training such as BOSIET and H2S Awareness.
* Must have a proficient level of both written and spoken communication skills in the English language, able to interpret and disseminate complex scope and contract documents


**About Us**
 Wood is a global leader in consulting and engineering, helping to unlock solutions to critical challenges in energy and materials markets. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in 45 countries, employing around 25,000 people. www.woodplc.com

data.jd_text:
Syntys is a leading data center provider specializing in the design, construction, and management of data centers, catering to hyperscalers, AI infrastructure, and colocation wholesale providers across the MENA region. With presence in more countries than any other provider in the region, Syntys is committed to delivering scalable, secure, and efficient digital infrastructure solutions.
 



  





 As a Senior Construction Project Manager (Data Centers), you will step into a pivotal client\-side leadership role, seamlessly integrating with executive teams to drive massive\-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion. This isn't just about managing timelines; it’s about strategic governance. You will take full ownership of the project lifecycle—managing program, cost, and exceptional quality standards—while effortlessly bridging the communication gap between key project stakeholders and the PMC. If you have a proven track record of steering complex data center builds to successful conclusions, we want you at the helm.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* **Strategic Governance:** 
 Provide overarching leadership to set up project teams, establish robust controls, implement quality standards, and offer critical buildability and technical advice.
* **Communication \& Liaison:** 
 Serve as the central focal point and strategic "filter" between the Client, consultants, and contractors to ensure fast, transparent, and effective information flow.
* **Risk \& Change Control:** 
 Proactively monitor the project Risk Plan (contingency and drawdowns) and rigorously manage the Change Control system.
* **Design Management:** 
 Facilitate design team/contractor procurement (including bid and contract placement) and manage the design process to ensure flawless execution of client requirements.
* **Site Operations:** 
 Oversee the release of timely CAIs (Confirmation of Architect's Instructions) with actionable build data, and strictly manage the coordination of Health \& Safety issues.
* **Financial Oversight:** 
 Manage construction budgets with a sharp focus on cost control, providing weekly financial updates, variance tracking, and risk/opportunity logs to senior leadership.
* **Milestone Tracking:** 
 Formalize and track detailed delivery programmes, paying critical attention to high\-level milestones, enabling works, and specialized sequences (e.g., BMS \& Commissioning).
* **Meeting Architecture:** 
 Establish and chair a structured cadence of meetings, including weekly client project/design meetings, fortnightly change control updates, and coordination/Value Engineering workshops.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Act as the bridge between specialized project tracks, maintaining close liaison with move teams, security, maintenance, IT, AV, and end\-users.
* **Contract Completion:** 
 Formally verify that all works are completed in strict accordance with contract parameters and manage the design team's snagging/de\-snagging process.
* **Documentation \& Compliance:** 
 Ensure full compilation of O\&M manuals, Health \& Safety files, and all necessary witnessing/testing documentation.



  





**What You’ll Bring (Qualifications \& Experience):**



* **Degree:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluency in
 **English** 
 is required;
 **Arabic** 
 language capability is a strong advantage.
* **Industry Veteran:** 
 Minimum of
 **10\+ years** 
 of construction management experience, with at least
 **5 years** 
 dedicated to data center construction or complex technology infrastructure projects.
* **Full\-Lifecycle Mastery:** 
 A proven track record of steering large\-scale projects through all phases: design, construction, and commissioning (Cx).
* **Critical Environments:** 
 Deep technical understanding of data center infrastructure, including cooling systems, critical power, fire suppression, and security systems.
* **Hyperscale \& Colocation:** 
 Direct experience working with hyperscalers or managing complex colocation facility builds.
* **Project Controls:** 
 Strong proficiency in contract administration and a solid understanding of Primavera P6 schedules.
* **Compliance \& Standards:** 
 Sharp knowledge of building codes, environmental regulations, and rigid health and safety compliance for high\-tech, high\-availability facilities.

data.jd_text:
**Data Centre, Technical \& Engineering Director** 




**Doha, Qatar** 




  





  






 Position Overview:
 




  





 The Technical \& Engineering Director position will be working within the businesses EPC Power \& Digital division, on all MENA data centre project.
 



  





 The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data centre projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



  





 Working in close alignment with the EPC Chief Operations Officer the Technical \& Engineering Director serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





 Some travel to construction sites across MENA will be required when necessary.
 



  






 Key Responsibilities:
 




  




* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)
* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants
* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections
* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework
* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements
* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements
* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off
* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers



  






 Qualifications \& Experience
 




  




* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data centre projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data centre projects
* Deep working knowledge of data centre power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets
* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)



  





 This is a full time, 5 days\-a\-week head office position in Doha, Qatar.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline (Master’s preferred).

**Tax Analyst \& Senior Tax Analyst**




**Job Title: Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 To deliver high\-quality technical analysis, research, and drafting that supports timely and consistent Advance Tax Ruling (ATR) decisions. The postholder will contribute to the full case lifecycle, ensuring analytical accuracy, procedural consistency and effective collaboration across technical and operational teams.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical support and drafting**


* Analyze ruling applications and supporting documentation to identify key issues.
* Research and interpret tax legislation, regulations, guidance, and relevant case law.
* Draft rulings, issue lists, and technical memoranda under the supervision of the Senior Tax Analyst.
* Prepare concise and well\-referenced summaries and comparative analyses.



  




1. **Case execution and collaboration**


* Coordinate with the Case Manager in ensuring completeness, document version control, and adherence to deadlines.
* Liaise with applicants to clarify information requests and coordinate responses for additional documentation.
* Prepare ruling case packs, meeting minutes, and decision logs for Senior Tax Analyst review.



  




1. **Quality and knowledge management**


* Apply approved templates, citations, and style guides consistently.
* Maintain and tag technical materials for future reference in the knowledge base.
* Track similar rulings to promote consistency and identify emerging policy trends.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, Public Administration.
* Minimum of four years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* Strong understanding of domestic tax laws, regional tax frameworks, and administrative practice.
* Proven analytical and legal interpretation skills and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication in Arabic and proficiency in English.



  





**Desirable** 



* Professional certifications such as CPA, ADIT, or CTA.
* Exposure to project management and information security basics.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Analytical rigor and research discipline.
* Clear and concise drafting with accurate citation.
* Proactive communication and effective team collaboration.
* Professional judgment, integrity and confidentiality.
* Reliability and adaptability under pressure and shifting priorities.



  





  





**Job Title: Senior Tax Analyst**




**Department: Advance Tax Rulings Section, Tax Policy Department** 




**Role purpose** 




 The Senior Tax Analyst is responsible for leading the technical review and drafting of Advance Tax Rulings (ATRs), ensuring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Qatari tax law and procedural standards. The postholder provides expert analysis, mentors junior analysts, and contributes to the quality, efficiency, and integrity of the rulings process
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



1. **Technical analysis and drafting**


* Lead the technical assessment of ruling applications, ensuring comprehensive analysis of facts and evidence.
* Interpret legislation, executive regulations, guidance, and relevant case law to support conclusions with validation and clear rationale.
* Draft technically sound high quality rulings and supporting memoranda, articulating options, risks, and impact of precedents.
* Identify information gaps and frame targeted clarification questions for applicants.



  




1. **Collaboration and review**


* Work closely with the Case Manager to ensure completeness, accuracy and adherence to case milestones.
* Coordinate with Legal Counsel, Audit, Policy, and Transfer Pricing specialists on cross\-functional cases.
* Review, augment and consolidate the draft work produced by Tax Analysts into a single structured package for Legal Counsel and Head of Section feedback.



  




1. **Hearings and stakeholder engagement**


* Participate in technical discussions, hearings and briefings, presenting findings clearly and objectively.
* Lead the preparation and delivery of concise technical briefings to the Head of Section .
* Contribute to controlled publication and redaction where applicable.



  




1. **Quality, governance, and improvement**


* Apply approved templates, citation standards, and documentation protocols consistently.
* Monitor the consistency of treatment across similar rulings to ensure fairness and legal soundness.
* Recommend updates to guidance materials, FAQs, and procedural templates based on case experience and emerging issues.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 




**Essential** 



* A certified Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field, such as Law, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, Economics, and Public Administration.
* Minimum seven years of experience in tax advisory, tax administration, or tax policy.
* In\-depth knowledge of domestic tax laws and related regulations, regional tax frameworks, international standards, and administrative practice.
* Strong legal interpretation and analytical skills with the ability to frame issues logically and persuasively.
* Excellent drafting ability, including clear reasoning and defensible conclusions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in Arabic with proficiency in English.
* Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with legal, policy or audit teams.



  





**Desirable** 



* CPA, ADIT, CTA, or an equivalent.



  





**Core competencies** 



* Technical depth with pragmatic judgment.
* Structured thinking and precision in drafting.
* Coaching and mentoring of junior staff.
* Integrity, confidentiality, and professional independence.
* Effective time management and Service Level Agreement discipline.

data.jd_text:
**Head of Faculty of English**
**Compass International School Doha, Qatar**
 Compass was established in 2006 to provide a premium British education to both expatriate and local Qatari families. We have three campuses; Al Themaid and Madinat Khalifa educate students from Early Years through to Secondary whereas Gharaffa is a stand\-alone Primary campus for children aged 3\-11\. All campuses offer a bespoke British curriculum. Secondary students can select from a wide range of IGSEs, AS and A levels. Additionally, we offer the prestigious IB Diploma Programme in Years 12 and 13\. All three sites offer a warm, friendly learning environment with our students at the heart of everything we do. We are proud of our outstanding teachers and our community feel. As for Qatar, a sunny climate year\-round and an airport with fantastic global connections ensures the continued popularity of this destination for expats.
   

  

 Our school has Qatar National Schools Accreditation (QNSA) and is a member of the British Schools in the Middle East (BSME), COBIS and AoBSO.
   

  

 To learn more about our school, please visit our website
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Faculty. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at Compass. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of faculty performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the faculty will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following essential attributes:
   

  

  

* 
+ university degree in a relevant specialist subject
+ teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
+ teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
+ strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* 
+ Job purpose
+ Reporting to
+ Key relationships
+ Key results areas
+ Performance measurement


**Benefits**
 Nord Anglia Education is the world's leading premium schools organisation. We are a fast\-paced and growing family of 80\+ international schools in China, Europe, the Middle East, South\-East Asia and The Americas, providing outstanding education to over 90,000 students from preschool to 18 years of age. Our schools are united by one philosophy\-we are ambitious for our students, our people, our community and family of schools. This means that we want every student to achieve more in our schools, than in any other schools in the world. We ensure this through personalised learning enhanced with bespoke global opportunities such as Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. We learn from the best and with the best.
   

  

 We offer you unsurpassed opportunities to innovate and develop best practice across our family, to access extensive professional development, and to gain exceptional experience and career development in our schools. At Nord Anglia, you will have opportunities to progress more, learn more, and collaborate more.
   

  

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.
   

  

 Alongside great training and a competitive package, you'll enjoy the chance to live and work in a rapidly growing country which is perhaps best known for successfully hosting the World Cup in 2022\. Qatar is a great place to be based for travel and enjoys a lovely climate most of the year.
   

  

**Essential**
**Experience / Qualifications Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ A university degree in English or a related subject
+ A teaching qualification (QTS)
+ At least 5 years of teaching experience within the British curriculum


**Desirable** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Prior middle leadership experience, for example as a Head of Subject
+ Master's degree, or other significant professional development
+ Previous international experience


**Personal Qualities Sought** 
  

  

  

* 
+ Fluent English speaker
+ Values\-led approach; integrity and honesty are paramount
+ Reliability, loyalty and commitment
+ Personal confidence and presence
+ Energetic and positive with a ‘can\-do' approach
+ Strong interpersonal skills
+ Effective communication skills, both orally and in writing
+ Approachable to all; able to show respect and display cultural sensitivity
+ Sense of humour and grace under pressure
+ Ability to understand complex issues and solve problems
+ Able to manage own time and prioritise; organized
+ Flexible and adaptable; able to handle uncertainty
+ Able to delegate effectively


**To apply**
 The application should be submitted online via the Nord Anglia Education Careers page.
   

  

 Online applications should contain a CV, a two\-page letter of application, and the details of three professional references, one of which should be a School Principal.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 1st August 2025
   

  

 The closing date for applications is
 **30th June 2026\.**
**Selection process**
 Interviews will be conducted face to face or via Teams.
   

  

 Candidates are encouraged to apply early as the school reserves the right to appoint before the closing date.
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people are able to thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils irrespective of race, ability, religion, gender or culture.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both Country of residence/birth and any Country of residence within the last 10 years.

 Our school has Qatar National Schools Accreditation (QNSA) and is a member of the British Schools in the Middle East (BSME), COBIS and AoBSO.
   

  

 To learn more about our school, please visit our website
   

  

**About You**
 You will be an exemplary teaching practitioner, with the ability to become an outstanding Head of Faculty. Together with the Senior Leadership Team, you will work to develop a vision for excellence and continual improvement at Compass. You must have the ability to lead and manage people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You should be capable of developing a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You will lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of faculty performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You should already demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation and the organisation of meetings.
   

  

 You will be asked to lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the faculty will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across Secondary school, and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

**You Will Have The Following Essential Attributes** 
  

  

* 
+ university degree in a relevant specialist subject
+ teaching qualification (QTS, PGCE/PDGE)
+ teaching experience in a UK and/or international context
+ strong working knowledge of the English national curriculum as relevant to your subject


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor’s degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery of a bespoke Secondary curriculum, built on the English National Curriculum and preparing student at Al Themaid for external examinations at IGSCE. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners, including those who have English as a second language, and you must be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Faculty, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting and for the professional development of teachers in your team.

 We offer a professional working environment and an attractive remuneration \& benefits package.

**Experience / Qualifications Sought**

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an exceptional
 **Head of Treasury** 
 to join our executive leadership team. This is a high\-impact role with direct accountability for restructuring and optimising the Group's debt capital structure, leading syndicated loan facilities with international banks, and building a world\-class treasury function that supports our multi\-vertical, multi\-geography growth strategy.
 



 The successful candidate will serve as the Group's primary interface with international banking partners, credit rating agencies, and institutional investors across diverse and often complex operating jurisdictions — ensuring robust liquidity management, financial risk governance, and regulatory compliance at both group and subsidiary level.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




***Debt Restructuring \& Capital Structure***




 ● Lead end\-to\-end debt restructuring initiatives, optimising the company's capital structure to reduce cost of debt and improve financial flexibility.
 



 ● Develop and execute debt management strategies including refinancing, covenant renegotiation, and balance sheet deleveraging.
 



 ● Oversee the full lifecycle of corporate borrowing facilities, ensuring alignment with business strategy and board\-approved leverage targets.
 



 ● Present debt strategy recommendations to the Holding CEO, Board, and Audit \& Risk Committee.
 



  





***Syndicated Loans \& International Banking Relationships***




 ● Lead the structuring, negotiation, and execution of syndicated loan facilities and bilateral credit agreements with international banking partners.
 



 ● Serve as the primary point of contact for the company's relationship banks, maintaining strong partnerships across global financial institutions.
 



 ● Manage the documentation process for loan agreements in collaboration with legal counsel and external advisors.
 



 ● Monitor compliance with loan covenants and proactively manage lender communications.
 



  





***Liquidity \& Cash Management***




 ● Oversee global cash management, liquidity forecasting, and working capital optimisation across all group entities.
 



 ● Implement and maintain a robust cash pooling structure to maximise internal efficiency and minimise external borrowing.
 



 ● Ensure the company maintains adequate liquidity buffers and committed facilities to meet operational and strategic needs.
 



  





***Risk Management \& Hedging***




 ● Design and implement hedging strategies to mitigate FX, interest rate, and commodity price risks in line with the Board\-approved risk appetite.
 



 ● Manage relationships with derivative counterparties and oversee ISDA documentation.
 



 ● Maintain compliance with treasury risk policies and financial reporting standards (IFRS 9 / hedge accounting).
 



  





***Governance, Reporting \& Strategy***




 ● Develop, implement, and enforce treasury policies, controls, and governance frameworks.
 



 ● Produce high\-quality treasury reporting for the Board, CFO, and external stakeholders including credit rating agencies.
 



 ● Support M\&A activity, capital raises, and other strategic finance initiatives from a treasury perspective.
 



 ● Lead, develop, and mentor the treasury team, fostering a high\-performance culture.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:**




***Essential***




 ● 18\+ years of progressive treasury experience, with at least 8 years in a senior treasury leadership role within a large corporate environment.
 



 ● Proven track record of leading complex debt restructuring programmes and/or refinancing transactions.
 



 ● Demonstrated experience negotiating and closing syndicated loan facilities with international banks.
 



 ● Deep expertise in cash management, liquidity risk, FX hedging, and interest rate risk management.
 



 ● Strong working knowledge of financial instruments, capital markets, and credit documentation (LMA standard preferred).
 



 ● Professional qualification: ACT (AMCT/MCT), CFA, ACA/ACCA, or equivalent.
 



 ● Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related discipline.
 



***Desirable***




 ● Proficiency with SAP TRM; familiarity with other treasury management systems is an advantage
 



 ● Experience operating within a large conglomerate or diversified holding group, with exposure to multiple business verticals and subsidiaries, preferably including contracting or infrastructure businesses.
 



 ● Prior exposure to treasury operations spanning the GCC, MENA, Africa, Central Asia, or frontier markets — experience in markets such as KSA, Iraq, Libya, Kazakhstan, or similar is a strong advantage.
 



 ● Background in managing treasury across diverse and complex operating jurisdictions, including countries with capital controls, currency restrictions, or limited banking infrastructure.
 



 ● Familiarity with ESG\-linked financing instruments (green bonds, sustainability\-linked loans).
 



 ● Exposure to high\-yield debt markets or leveraged finance structures.
 



 ● Experience interfacing with group\-level governance, intercompany treasury arrangements, and intra\-group lending frameworks across multiple sectors.
 



  





**Leadership \& Competencies**




 ●Strategic Thinking — Ability to translate complex financial dynamics into clear, actionable treasury strategies.
 



 ● Executive Presence — Credible and confident in presenting to Boards, rating agencies, and senior banking partners.
 



 ● Negotiation Skills — Track record of delivering favourable terms in complex, multi\-party banking negotiations.
 



 ● Risk Mindset — Disciplined approach to identifying, quantifying, and mitigating financial risk.
 



 ● People Leadership — Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high\-performing teams.
 



 ● Integrity \& Governance — Highest standards of professional conduct and financial controls.
 



  





 \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
 



**About the Group** 




 Estithmar Holding is a Qatar\-based diversified investment holding group operating across five core business verticals: Infrastructure \& Contracting Ventures, Property Development, Hospitality \& Healthcare, Financial Services, and a Services Group encompassing Manpower, Facilities Management, and Catering. With an active and growing footprint across the Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, and beyond — including operations in Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Libya, Syria, Kazakhstan, Rwanda, the Maldives, Albania, Algeria, Egypt, and Venezuela — the Group manages a complex, multi\-currency portfolio of businesses and investments requiring sophisticated treasury leadership

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The incumbent will supervise all Money Market activities for the Group’s international operations in a cost\-effective manner in accordance with the Group’s strategy, risk appetite, regulatory requirements, policies and procedures and the delegated authority.
   

  

 Main Responsibilities
   

  

* Shareholder \& Financial: \- Complies with approved budgets, policies and procedures in relation to Group International MM operations. \- Assists in the implementation of annual business plans for the area of responsibility with emphasis on achievement of set targets/ objectives, business growth and expansion in the Group International MM Desk. \- Implements and evaluates of best practice work methods in area of responsibility to achieve optimum level of performance efficiency. \- Implements KPI’s and best practices for Vice President, International Treasury role. \- Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank. \- Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent
* Customer (Internal \& External): \- Builds and maintains strong and effective relationships with all other related units to achieve the Group International MM Desk goals/objectives. \- Provides timely and accurate information to the external and internal auditors, the Compliance function and Group Risk as and when required. \- Assists in maintaining relationships with key international entities requiring money market services \- To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests. \- Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): \- Performs activities and monitor subordinates in compliance to the department’s policies and procedures for conducting buy/ sell deals in various currencies, maintaining/ collating MIS pertaining to profitability/ revenue, and observing compliance with the applicable limits approved by the Board/ its delegated authorities. \- Monitors/ performs trading in various money market instruments such as deposits, loans, short\-term securities, forward rate agreements and interest rate swaps in approved currencies and with approved counterparties on the behalf of the Group’s international operations. \- Ensures compliance to set Money Markets limits for each international entity and recommends any changes to the SVP, International Treasury, when required. \- Follows\-up on the timely processing of Group International MM deals in coordination with Treasury Operations. \- Provides pricing support for subsidiary departments and branches in foreign currency MM products. \- Monitors gap positions for each subsidiary, and ensure positions are within QCB guidelines. \- Supervises the production of daily rate sheets. \- Assists the SVP, International Treasury in the provision of MM solutions to meet customers’ and the Group Internationals hedging requirements. \- Manages the process of preparing daily rate sheets. \- Monitors and analyze the international markets to be able to trade profitable positions and advise direct subordinate within the delegated authority. \- Supports in the provision of accurate reporting of P\&L figures of all MM activities and revalue outstanding positions to EVP, Group Treasury Trading on daily, weekly and monthly basis. \- Is involved in the structuring of MM products, as and when deemed necessary by the SVP, Treasury Structured Products and Derivatives, in consultation with SVP, International Treasury.
* Learning \& Knowledge: \- Monitors performance of direct reports and guide them in managing their performance by providing appropriate feedback.\- Identifies related areas for professional development of self and all direct reports, and act to enhance professional development of self and others. \- Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field.
* Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: \- Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML \& CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). \- Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks. \- Ensure systematic good outcomes for clients in accordance with Conduct Risk policy. \- Support the framework of RCSA, KRI, Incident reporting and remediation, as appropriate, in accordance with the Operational Risk Management requirements. \- Maintain appropriate knowledge to ensure full qualification to undertake the role. \- Complete all mandatory training provided by the Bank, attain, and maintain the required levels of competence. \- Attend mandatory (internal and external) seminars as instructed by the Bank.
* Other: \- Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. \- Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. \- Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. \- All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.


**Education/Experience Requirements**
 Education and Experience Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s University graduate preferably with a Major in , Banking, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration
* MBA, CFA, or a related professional certification is a plus.
* Minimum 12 years’ experience in active MM dealing room,


 Note: you will be required to attach the following:
   

  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate

**Job Description**
 Parsons is working with leading public service organizations to orchestrate large scale O\&M transformation for roads activities for programs that drives Service Delivery Excellence, Operational Efficiencies, Capability Building, Change Management, and Outsource Maximization.
   

  

 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Asset Manager Lead** 
 to join our team! In this role you will manage large Roads Operations and Maintenance portfolio on behalf of the client. The Asset Manager Lead will demonstrate technical and professional competency in roads asset management that improves planning, management, and operation \& maintenance of urban transportation systems.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Employ and manage a full time Asset Management Contract Performance Area support team to deliver the Scope of Services
* Provide support for the development of Asset Management capabilities.
* Review all existing Asset Management Strategies and Plans and recommend improvements to strengthen the Affairs’ Asset Management processes.
* Review for suitability all activities which support the Asset Management function i.e., condition surveys, asset inventories, data management, value management, risk\-based hierarchies, performance measures etc.
* Develop and support in implementation of methodologies for optimizing the whole life costs of the asset groups.
* Assess the data available for all assets and develop the data requirements and capabilities for data\-driven decision making.
* Assess the risk of Climate Change and Climate Variability in the Road and Drainage Networks and provide recommendations to Management on the pathways for improving the levels of Climate Change Resilience.
* Develop and implement a robust change management system which can capture change requirements and deliver change (short/long term, planned/unplanned) efficiently with minimized risk to the ongoing operations.
* Track ongoing changes in International Standards and codes of Practice and make recommendations for internal changes to reflect new requirements.
* Identify the need for changes/upgrades to assets/systems hardware and software and deliver the change in a structured manner according to standard change management processes.
* Support the Stakeholder Engagement activities and ensure that change is managed collaboratively though the buy\-in of all stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**1\. Job Purpose** 




  





 To provide administrative support to the Board of Directors and associated committees. Execute streamlining of board communication and collaboration, overseeing logistics, documentation, feedback, planning, and compliance for enhanced governance and organizational success, providing comprehensive support to enhance board performance and uphold standards.
 



  





**2\. Position Accountability Description** 




**Board Operations Management** 




  




1. Formulate and maintain a comprehensive board operations manual to guide activities effectively, ensuring clarity and alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Incorporate regular staff input for continuous improvements and superior functionality, resulting in a more robust and user\-friendly manual.
2. Collaborate with executive leadership to meticulously draft, review, and finalize board meeting agendas and materials, incorporating feedback, fostering collaboration, and ensuring adherence to governance and compliance requirements.
3. Arrange logistical details for board meetings, meticulously overseeing scheduling, venue selection, catering arrangements, technology setup, and promptly resolving any unforeseen challenges.
4. Provide and distribute meeting materials to board members in advance, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, customization according to preferences, secure distribution channels, and thorough content coverage.
5. Support board affairs director to analyze board meetings to record precise minutes, capturing nuanced discussions, decisions, action items, key points, highlighting follow\-ups, and facilitating efficient dissemination and implementation of outcomes.
6. Distribute prepared action plans coming out of the board \& committees meetings to relevant parties and follow up on the implementation of action plans.



  





**Document and Information Management** 




  




1. Track an organized repository of board documents meticulously, ensuring systematic categorization, version control, security protocols, accessible data, confidentiality, and streamlined retrieval processes for enhanced operational efficiency.
2. Undertake board member onboarding processes strategically, offering tailored induction sessions, facilitating informed access to pertinent resources, enabling seamless integration, fostering relationships, aligning with strategic goals, and promoting engagement.
3. Contribute to and collect detailed feedback from directors to compile comprehensive reports, analyzing insights, trends, performance metrics, and areas for improvement, and presenting synthesized recommendations for concerned committee review and strategic decision\-making.
4. Analyze board member evaluations and self\-assessment processes, compiling results, identifying areas for improvement, and recommending development opportunities to enhance board performance, while tracking progress, providing personalized feedback, and ensuring alignment with the board's goals.



  





**Board Communication and Support** 




  




1. Serve as the primary point of contact for board \& committees inquiries, managing communications professionally, providing timely responses, clarifying information, addressing concerns skillfully, nurturing relationships, and upholding a positive board \& committees experience.
2. Support board affairs director to Aadvise Board and Committee members on tailored communications strategies, fostering effective interactions with internal and external stakeholders, enhancing transparency and alignment, fostering collaboration, and promoting a harmonious working environment for organizational success.
3. Establish and maintain effective communication channels between the board and senior management, ensuring key information flows smoothly and providing timely updates on organizational performance and strategic initiatives.



  





**Event Coordination** 




  




1. Coordinate board retreats and strategic planning sessions, including agenda development, facilitator selection, and the creation of supporting materials to drive productive discussions and outcomes.
2. Prepare a comprehensive annual calendar of board and committee activities, meetings, and events, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timely notification to all board members, incorporating feedback, key deadlines, and strategic milestones for optimal planning.
3. Help to create and execute special board events, such as recognition ceremonies, award presentations, and networking opportunities, to foster camaraderie and appreciation among board members, coordinating guest speakers, thematic elements, and leveraging social media to highlight achievements.



  





**Governance and Compliance** 




  




1. Oversee the development and maintenance of a comprehensive board and committees members skills matrix, identifying gaps and recommending targeted recruitment to ensure a diverse and effective board, incorporating emerging competencies, succession planning needs, and strategic alignment with organizational goals.
2. Support the Chairman in conducting board evaluations, compiling performance metrics, and providing actionable insights and recommendations for enhancing board effectiveness by facilitating post\-evaluation discussions, addressing identified issues, clarifying roles, and setting clear improvement goals.
3. Ensure compliance with all governance policies and procedures, conducting regular reviews, recommending updates, and ensuring adherence to ethical standards and legal requirements, while integrating best practices, stakeholder feedback, and proactive risk management strategies for continuous improvement. Ensure all rules and bylaws are adhered to by the board \& committees members during meetings and in the implementation of their decisions.



  





**Innovation and Continuous Improvement** 




  




1. Continuously benchmark Board operations practices against industry standards, adopting improvements to enhance efficiency and governance effectiveness.
2. Implement and monitor process improvements by analyzing current Board operations practices, identifying inefficiencies, and applying best practices to streamline workflows.
3. Explore and adopt new technologies and tools that can improve Board operations, keeping the team at the forefront of innovation and efficiency.
4. Foster a high\-performance culture by striving for excellence and encouraging peers, contributing to the overall success and continuous improvement of the Board operations team.



  





**Team Collaboration and Continuous Learning** 




  




1. Work collaboratively with team members and DACO management by sharing knowledge, providing support, and actively participating in team activities to foster a positive and productive work environment.
2. Engage in continuous learning by seeking feedback, attending training sessions, and staying updated on industry trends to enhance personal skills and professional growth.



  





  





 3\. Minimum Job Requirements
 


* 
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of progressive experience in board management, corporate governance, compliance, legal or a related field.

Aftermarket services such as spare parts, repairs, upgrades, field services, engineering evaluations, reliability and performance assessments, troubleshooting, training, remote diagnostics/data monitoring, and shop services are some of the many offerings provided from regional service centers for both Air Products and non\-Air Products equipment.
   

  

 We are seeking an
 **Rotoflow** 
**Aftermarket Project Manager** 
 at our turbomachinery service center in KSA\- DSC, responsible for providing projects execution with engineering support for spare parts, repairs, upgrades, reverse engineering, and field service of all types of turbomachinery.
   

  

**You Will Enjoy**
* Be part of a team to grow a world\-class service and machinery business.
* Seeing the results of candidate’s direct efforts through successful execution of customer projects.
* Being empowered to satisfy customers and have influence on changes to work processes to meet customer expectations on speed and world\-class customer service.
* Collaborating with a cross\-functional team across commercial, engineering, procurement and manufacturing on a wide variety of projects with varying technical complexity and scope.
* Significant direct interaction with customers, in coordination with account managers, ensures Rotoflow exceeds customer expectations with solutions.

**Responsibilities**
* Work collaboratively with Proposal Managers to receive assigned orders, develop and implement appropriate execution plans that address execution, budget, and schedule, and put in place a team that can successfully execute.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of executing service orders for the compression fleet, driving meaningful projects that enhance operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Your role will involve strategic planning and coordination, ensuring that projects are delivered within scope, time, quality, and budget, thereby contributing significantly to Siemens Energy’s mission of sustainable energy solutions. You will work in a dynamic team environment that values collaboration, innovation, and proactive communication, fostering a culture of growth and excellence.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute compression service orders, including parts, repairs, field service, and complete outage projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* Manage customer relationships during order execution, acting as their advocate within the organization and enhancing communication across service offerings.
* Organize and lead teams, define responsibilities, develop schedules, and allocate resources to address specific project challenges effectively.
* Extend service order management to the Middle Eastern region as needed, ensuring seamless execution and delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to achieve revenue, EBIT, on\-time delivery, and project delivery targets, while driving client satisfaction and supporting cash collection.
* Collaborate with finance for accurate forecasting and coordinate with global teams to align service order execution with global standards.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related field, with 4\-6 years of relevant experience in project management, preferably in the Oil \& Gas industry or with rotating equipment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills, with the ability to develop and implement strategic plans effectively.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with project management and order management tools and concepts.
* Self\-driven and adaptable, with a positive attitude and the ability to solve challenges collaboratively.
* Familiarity with CRM (Salesforce) and ERP software (e.g., SAP) is highly desirable, enhancing operational efficiency.
* Excellent communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills, with strong leadership abilities to influence stakeholders and drive project success.


**About The Team**
 Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.
