* Demonstrated experience identifying ERP gaps, scoping improvements, leading delivery, and driving adoption with finance teams.
* Solid technical literacy — comfortable reading system specs, understanding integrations, APIs, and data flows, reviewing configurations with engineers, and making informed scope and priority decisions.
* Strong product\-owner / business\-analyst skill set — discovery, requirements documentation, user stories, UAT, success measurement.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to push back constructively and align senior finance and tech leaders.
* Working proficiency with Jira, Notion, Miro, and basic productivity tools.
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems — particularly the Accounting, Invoicing, Payments, Reporting modules, etc.
* Experience with ERP version migrations or upgrades on live systems.
* Exposure to high\-growth, multi\-entity, multi\-currency environments — ideally in tech, e\-commerce, fintech, or super\-app companies.
* Familiarity with payment gateway integrations, bank connectors, and reconciliation automation.
* Experience working embedded in or alongside a software engineering team — understanding the development lifecycle, sprint ceremonies, and technical trade\-offs.
* Process improvement background (Lean / Six Sigma / Agile).


**✨ Bonus Points If You Have**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field; an MBA or equivalent is welcome.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Visa Consulting Manager will be a key member of the VCA organization in MENA and will contribute to the commercial traction, product development and thought leadership across practice areas. The role will also deliver subject matter expertise and consulting support to VISA's key clients across clusters. The main objective of the role is to help deepen client relationships and optimize client performance by helping them design and assess their payments strategy and implement initiatives to capture the full potential from enhancing customers engagement.
   

  

**Principal Responsibilities/Key Results Area**
* Collaborate with VCA colleagues, Visa account executives and other Visa functions to cultivate and manage a pipeline of engagement opportunities with the largest banks and merchants in the region
* Lead and/or serve as a subject matter expert on consulting engagements across practice areas (portfolio, digital, risk) including but not limited to the following,
+ Using VISA and external data to analyze client needs across the focus markets and identify opportunities for consulting assignments with VISA’s key clients
+ Support and contribute to sales pitches
+ Lead or contribute to internal problem\-solving sessions
+ Prepare for, and participate in, client discussions
+ Be involved in project deliveries in both coordination and delivery role
+ Work closely with other VISA groups, including Products, Business Development, Risk, Marketing, Digital Solutions, Digital Partnerships \& Ventures, Innovation Center etc., to ensure a seamless Consulting experience
+ Contribute to the development, when needed, of practice areas in terms of product development


**Key Competencies**
* A well\-qualified candidate will have broad and deep expertise in Payments Consulting across multiple areas of focus. Key elements to assess his/her candidacy will include expertise on the following topics,
* Business needs of issuers, acquirers and merchants in Portfolio, Digital, and Risk e.g., strategy, acquisition, customers and channels full potential, innovation, mobile platforms, digital ecosystems, authorization etc.

 This is a hybrid position. Hybrid employees can alternate time between both remote and office. * Deep consulting skills and client engagement capabilities. Advanced client management and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and VISA.

* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Results driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site for extended periods across MENA.
* Self\-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with inter\-disciplinary groups.
* Ability to work in a multi\-cultural environment.
* Fluency in English mandatory. Arabic desired but not a prerequisite

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

**Description**
**About the role**
 Qatar Airways are pleased to announce an incredibly exciting opportunity to join our Distribution team as a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments) to be based in Doha, Qatar.
   

  

 As a Commercial Efficiency Manager (Payments), you will own the commercial payment strategy and operational framework for Qatar Airways' indirect distribution channels; ensuring that payment method acceptance, cost of sale management, policy governance, and payment programme performance across indirect channels are delivered with commercial discipline and measurable efficiency. You will also be responsible for developing and maintaining the indirect channel payment roadmap, driving the adoption of preferred payment methods, monitoring payment\-related costs, and ensuring that all payment policies and processes across indirect channels are clearly defined, consistently enforced, and continuously improved. In this role you will work in close coordination with the Manager Payments for the direct channel and the Head of Payments in Finance to maintain a coherent, cross\-channel view of Qatar Airways' payment economics, while holding clear primary ownership of the indirect channel.
   

  

**Specific Responsibilities For The Role Include**
* Define and maintain the indirect channel payment strategy by establishing Qatar Airways' commercial position on payment method acceptance, preferred payment method prioritisation, cost of sale targets, and payment policy frameworks across GDS, NDC, aggregator, and other indirect connect channels; ensuring alignment with the broader commercial direction.
* Develop and own the indirect channel payment roadmap by identifying, prioritizing, and sequencing payment capability improvements, new payment method introductions, and legacy method rationalization across indirect channels; grounded in sound business cases with clear commercial outcomes, measurable ROI, and realistic delivery timelines, in full coordination with market and segment owners.
* Monitor and manage Qatar Airways' payment cost of sale across indirect channels on a continuous basis by tracking payment method costs, acquirer fees, scheme charges, and processing costs by channel and market; producing regular, accurate reporting that gives the Commercial and Finance teams a clear view of payment economics, cost trends, and variance against target.
* Drive the adoption of preferred and lower\-cost payment methods across indirect channels by working with trade partners, distribution partners, and channel owners to actively shift the payment mix towards methods that improve Qatar Airways' net revenue position and reduce distribution cost of sale over time.
* Own and maintain the indirect channel payment policy framework by defining, documenting, and enforcing payment acceptance policies, surcharging rules, local payment method guidelines, and agency payment terms across all indirect distribution channels while ensuring policies are consistently applied across markets and regularly reviewed for commercial relevance and compliance.
* Coordinate and manage business cases for all payment\-related investment and change initiatives; including new payment method implementations, acquirer contract changes, technology upgrades, and cost optimisation programmes while ensuring all proposals are commercially justified, financially modelled, and presented with clear recommendations.
* Coordinate with finance on subjects related to acquirers and payment service providers; supporting contractual reviews, RFP processes, and commercial negotiations while ensuring that acquirer relationships and contract terms reflect Qatar Airways' commercial objectives and cost targets.
* Manage agency payment processes and policy compliance across indirect channels; including agency payment terms, ADM\-related payment disputes, and breach management by ensuring that trade partner payment behaviour is monitored, non\-compliance is addressed promptly, and corrective action is tracked through to resolution.
* Work with Finance on payment fraud prevention and cost protection by coordinating fraud monitoring, recovery mechanism implementation, and payment card fee optimization; ensuring that fraud\-related risks and costs are actively managed and do not erode the commercial efficiency of indirect channel payment operations.
* Support the activation of new destinations and distribution channels from a payment readiness perspective by assessing local payment method requirements, provisioning appropriate payment options, and ensuring payment infrastructure is in place before commercial launch.

Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before.
   

  

 Together, everything is possible.
   

  

 Qualification
   

  

**About You**
 The successful candidate will have the following skills and qualifications:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or related field with minimum 7 years of job\-related experience.
* Experience in payments, commercial strategy, airline distribution, or financial operations within aviation, travel, or e\-commerce environments.
* Proven experience managing payment strategy, cost optimisation, and commercial performance across multiple channels (GDS, NDC, aggregators, or similar ecosystems).
* Experience with financial modelling, dashboards, and performance tracking tools (Excel, Power BI, Tableau).
* Experience building business cases with ROI modelling and financial forecasting.
* Strong knowledge of global payment ecosystems, including card schemes, alternative payment methods, acquirers, PSPs, and settlement processes.
* Deep understanding of payment cost drivers.
* Strong understanding of agency payment flows, settlement processes, and industry standards.
* Strong analytical skills with ability to translate data into actionable insights.
* Strong commercial acumen with ability to drive payment method adoption strategies.
* Ability to define and execute cost of sale optimisation strategies.
* Excellent command of spoken and written English.


**About Qatar Airways Group**
 Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellence across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down by the fear of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries, and be part of a truly global community.

data.jd_text:
A new financial markets infrastructure venture is being established in Oman, backed by prominent institutional investors and operating under an international common law framework. The platform is a greenfield central securities depository being built to go\-live in 2027\.
 



  





 We are hiring a Head of Product Technology to own the technology platform end\-to\-end: the application and the infrastructure on which it runs. This is not background plumbing. The application is the product. The infrastructure is the foundation on which settlement finality, system resilience, latency performance, and operational availability are delivered. The post\-holder must understand both layers as one integrated whole and own them as one.
 



  





 In Build, the post\-holder is the architect of the platform from a blank sheet: technology reference architecture, infrastructure topology, hosting strategy, network and database design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and disaster\-recovery architecture. In Run, the same person operates the platform and the team they have designed. This is not a sit\-in\-your\-office role.
 



  





**What the role covers** 



* Designing the technology reference architecture from a blank sheet: application architecture, infrastructure topology, database platform, network design, integration patterns, security architecture, and resilience and DR architecture
* Owning the application end\-to\-end: design, configuration, integration, data model, change management, and support
* Owning the infrastructure that hosts the platform: compute, storage, network, virtualisation, database, and middleware, whether on\-premise, hosted, or cloud
* Owning platform resilience: high availability design, backup and recovery architecture, disaster recovery, business continuity, and tested failover
* Owning end\-to\-end platform performance including transaction latency, capacity planning, and headroom strategy
* Owning first\-line platform security: secure configuration, hardening, identity and access management, vulnerability management, patching, and security incident response
* Owning the technical relationship with the build vendor; holding them to account on functional, technical, and operational delivery
* Designing the human operating model for the platform: team shape, shift patterns, on\-call rotations, incident command structure, runbooks, and third\-party support arrangements
* Owning all integrations between the platform and external systems: custodians, settlement banks, exchange, SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ISIN infrastructure
* Line managing the Application Managers, Database Administrator, and the wider platform engineering team as it builds



  





**Who we are looking for** 




 At least 12 years in financial\-services platform technology, with substantial time spent owning a mission\-critical platform end\-to\-end across both application and infrastructure layers. Direct, demonstrable experience architecting a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet: this is non\-negotiable. Direct, demonstrable experience as the technical authority on a CSD, custody platform, post\-trade platform, capital markets platform, or core banking system of comparable mission\-criticality: also non\-negotiable.
 



  





 Hands\-on technical credibility across both application and infrastructure layers: able to read code, query a database, design a network topology, debug an integration, and challenge a vendor's technical decisions with authority. Demonstrated experience holding a major build vendor or system integrator to account on technical delivery. Deep understanding of how a regulated financial\-services business works, not just the technology underneath it. Fluent in English.
 



  





 Experience in financial market infrastructure (CSD, CCP, exchange, or payment system) is an advantage. So is familiarity with CPMI\-IOSCO principles and experience designing SWIFT, Bloomberg, and ICSD integrations.
 



  





**What this is** 




 The platform does not exist yet. The architecture has not been designed, the infrastructure has not been built, and the operating model has not been written. The person who takes this role will have done all of it. If you have genuinely architected and owned a mission\-critical regulated financial platform from a blank sheet, and you have the hands\-on credibility and delivery drive to do it again, this is worth a conversation.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **VP – Infrastructure, Cloud and Operations** 
 , reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. The role will lead enterprise\-wide infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, and technology operations, ensuring a secure, scalable, and high\-performance digital foundation across Dubai Holding’s diverse portfolio.
 



  





 This is a critical leadership role driving the evolution of infrastructure from traditional operations to AI\-enabled, autonomous platforms, while ensuring strong commercial discipline, resilience, and service excellence.
 



  





 If you are ready to operate at the intersection of technology, business, and transformation, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Infrastructure Strategy \& Transformation** 



* Define and execute Dubai Holding’s enterprise infrastructure and cloud strategy aligned to business growth and digital ambitions
* Lead large\-scale transformation of legacy environments into modern, cloud\-native and hybrid platforms
* Establish governance frameworks, standards, and policies ensuring security, scalability, and operational consistency
* Drive resilience strategies including disaster recovery, business continuity, and infrastructure risk management



**Cloud \& Platform Leadership** 



* Lead multi\-cloud and hybrid cloud strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments
* Oversee cloud migration, optimization, and cloud\-native adoption across business units
* Implement infrastructure\-as\-code and automation frameworks to accelerate deployment and scalability
* Build strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and leading infrastructure providers



**Operations \& Service Excellence** 



* Own end\-to\-end IT infrastructure operations and service delivery across all business units
* Implement ITIL\-aligned service management practices, including incident, change, and problem management
* Ensure 24/7 monitoring, performance optimization, and uptime across critical systems
* Establish SLAs, KPIs, and continuous improvement frameworks for operational excellence



**Commercial \& Financial Leadership** 



* Own infrastructure P\&L including total cost of ownership across on\-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments
* Develop business cases for infrastructure investments, clearly articulating ROI and value realization
* Drive FinOps maturity, including cost transparency, showback/chargeback models, and cloud optimization strategies
* Lead negotiations with hyperscalers, telecom providers, and strategic vendors to optimize commercial outcomes
* Establish infrastructure unit economics (e.g., cost per workload, user, or transaction) to enable data\-driven decisions
* Partner with Finance and Procurement to ensure governance, cost control, and scalable investment planning



**Network, Data Center \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee infrastructure lifecycle across compute, storage, and networking environments
* Lead network strategy including LAN, WAN, and connectivity across multiple assets and locations
* Drive virtualization, containerization, and platform optimization initiatives
* Ensure robust infrastructure security and performance across all environments



**Agentic AI\-Ready Infrastructure** 



* Architect AI\-native infrastructure platforms supporting large\-scale deployment of AI agents and advanced workloads
* Lead transition toward autonomous operations, including self\-healing infrastructure and predictive operations
* Enable intelligent orchestration of infrastructure resources based on real\-time demand and business context
* Define strategy for GPU and compute environments supporting AI, LLMs, and advanced analytics workloads
* Establish governance, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop frameworks for AI\-driven infrastructure operations
* Drive cultural transformation toward AI\-enabled operations and reduced manual intervention



**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management** 



* Partner with executive leadership to align infrastructure investments with strategic priorities
* Manage vendor ecosystem including cloud providers, MSPs, and telecom partners
* Oversee contract negotiations, performance management, and vendor governance frameworks
* Ensure alignment with security, architecture, and governance functions across the enterprise



**Leadership \& Capability Building** 



* Build and lead high\-performing infrastructure, cloud, and operations teams
* Define organization structure and capability roadmap across infrastructure and cloud functions
* Drive talent development, certifications, and future skills in cloud, automation, and AI\-enabled operations
* Foster collaboration across IT and business units to deliver integrated technology services



  





**Who we are looking for** 



* 18\+ years of experience in IT infrastructure, cloud, and operations, with significant leadership exposure in complex enterprise environments
* Proven track record in leading large\-scale infrastructure and cloud transformations
* Strong experience managing multi\-vendor ecosystems and enterprise\-scale infrastructure platforms
* Deep expertise across data centers, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and network environments
* Demonstrated experience in financial management of infrastructure, including cost optimization and vendor commercial strategies
* Experience operating at executive level, influencing senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field required
* Master’s degree preferred
* Certifications in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) highly valued
* ITIL, infrastructure, or project management certifications advantageous



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Enterprise infrastructure architecture (compute, storage, networking, virtualization)
* Cloud computing platforms and hybrid/multi\-cloud strategies
* Infrastructure automation, orchestration, and IaC frameworks
* Network architecture, security, and performance management
* IT service management and ITIL practices
* Infrastructure financial management and cost optimization



  





**Behavioral Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking and transformation leadership
* Strong commercial and business acumen
* Executive stakeholder management and influence
* Problem solving and decision\-making in complex environments
* Ability to lead large, diverse technical teams



  





 As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to the high volumes of applications, only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.
 



  





 This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.

**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Manager, Data Domain and Products is accountable for governing, coordinating, and enabling a portfolio of data domains and their associated data products, rather than owning a single domain directly.
   

  

 The role ensures that domain data owners (Principal Specialists) operate within a consistent enterprise framework for data products, governance, quality, and value realization. It acts as the portfolio‑level authority, aligning domain priorities with enterprise strategy, resolving cross‑domain conflicts, and ensuring that data products are delivered as reusable, governed assets rather than siloed solutions.
   

  

 This role is responsible for how data domains operate together, how data products are prioritized and standardized, and how domain outputs collectively support enterprise reporting, operations, controls, and decision‑making.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide leadership and oversight across multiple data domains, each owned by a designated domain owner
* Ensure domain owners apply consistent principles for data ownership, stewardship, modeling, quality, and governance.
* Balance demand across domains by prioritizing data products based on enterprise value, regulatory need, and readiness.
* Ensure domain data products integrate cleanly with enterprise platforms and downstream consumers.
* Act as the primary business‑facing interface for enterprise data domains, translating strategic needs into coordinated domain roadmaps.
* Enable domain owners to focus on execution by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and clarifying priorities.
* Ensure lifecycle artifacts (ownership, definitions, quality expectations, refresh SLAs) are consistently produced across domains.
* Lead and develop domain owners, ensuring clarity of role boundaries between domain ownership and enterprise oversight.


**Minimum Qualification, Experience And Competencies**
**Minimum Qualification**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Computing, or related field.
* MBA or Master’s degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage.


**Minimum Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience across data, analytics, or enterprise information management
* Proven experience leading multiple data domains or portfolios, not just a single domain
* Demonstrated ability to manage senior specialists and influence cross‑functional stakeholders


**Skills**
* Portfolio‑level data domain and product management
* Enterprise data governance and operating models
* Cross‑domain KPI and semantic alignment

**About Us:** 




 Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting\-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.
 



 A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best\-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS\_News.
 



  





**Job Description:**




  





 An L1 (Level 1\) Back Office (BO) Support Agent provides initial administrative, technical, or operational support to ensure smooth business functioning. They serve as a "behind\-the\-scenes" frontline agent, processing data, resolving routine requests, and escalating complex issues to L2 support, acting as a bridge between internal teams and client\-facing staff.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 · Ticket Management: Receive, log, acknowledge, and classify incoming requests, incidents, or alerts via email, chat, or ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy).
 



 · Data Processing \& Entry: Enter, update, and maintain accurate records in databases, CRM systems, or ERP software.
 



 · Routine Troubleshooting: Provide first\-line fixes for basic issues such as password resets, account unlocking, software installation, or routine IT application support.
 



 · Documentation \& Reporting: Prepare daily/weekly reports on operational metrics, process documentation (e.g., invoices, bills of lading), and maintain accurate filing systems.
 



 · Escalation: Route complex or unresolved problems to L2/L3 technical teams or managers.
 



 · Vendor/Internal Coordination: Coordinate with internal departments or external vendors to process orders, manage inventory, or request support.
 



 · System Monitoring: Monitor application health or server alerts to identify potential bottlenecks or failures.
 



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 




  





 · Technical Proficiency: Strong knowledge of MS Office Suite (especially Excel—Pivot Tables, VLookup), and familiarity with CRM or ERP tools.
 



 · Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for updating stakeholders and documenting issues.
 



 · Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to data entry to prevent costly errors.
 



 · Time Management: Ability to work under tight deadlines and prioritize tasks effectively.
 



 · Education: Typically requires a high school diploma or a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, IT, or a related field.
 



 Common Roles \& Contexts
 



 · IT Service Desk L1: Remote troubleshooting, Active Directory management, O365 support.
 



 · BO Executive (Finance/HR): Managing employee records, invoicing, and payroll data.
 



 · Operational Support: Order management, tracking deliveries, and vendor coordination.
 



  





**Application Deadline: 20\-June\-2026** 




  





**Privacy Note:** 




 https://www.tcs.com/connect\-with\-tcs/privacy\-policy

A multi\-asset trading group is looking to hire their first head of IT to own and run the global IT function across the group. Lead a small team, manage the stack hands\-on, and keep a 24/7 trading environment running.
 



**Mandatory Sector Experience** 




 Applications will only be considered from candidates with recent IT leadership experience inside one of the following: FX/CFD brokerages, crypto exchanges, banks, FinTechs or payments institutions. Trading infrastructure exposure is essential. Candidates from outside regulated trading environments will not be progressed.
 



**Responsibilities** 



* Own IT strategy, budget, service standards and SLAs
* Lead and grow the IT team, including helpdesk and engineering, with 24/7 cover
* Administer Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft 365, Exchange Online and Intune
* Run Windows Server (DNS, DHCP, GPO, domain controllers), backups, patching and endpoint security
* Own the Fortinet stack (FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiClient EMS), VPN, firewall policy and segmentation
* Govern user lifecycle, access controls and joiner\-mover\-leaver with HR
* Develop and enforce IT policy, audits, BCP and ITIL\-aligned operations
* Manage vendors, telecoms providers and managed service partners
* Lead infrastructure upgrades, cloud migrations and automation projects



**Required** 



* 8\+ years IT and systems administration, with leadership experience
* Recent role inside an FX/CFD broker, crypto exchange, bank, FinTech or payments institution
* Hands\-on depth across Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Windows Server and Intune
* Fortinet across firewalls, VPN and security monitoring
* Multi\-office, multi\-jurisdiction support experience
* ITIL fluency, strong documentation discipline
* Available for 24/7 on\-call



**Preferred** 



* SOC2 or ISO 27001 exposure
* Fortinet NSE 4\+, Network\+/Security\+, ITIL v4



**Location** 




 Dubai, onsite. Relocation supported for the right candidate.
 



**PACKAGE** 




**Base salary in the region of AED 40,000 to 50,000 per month (approximately USD 130,000 to 165,000 per annum), paid in AED. Performance\-related annual bonus. ESOP participation. Standard UAE benefits**

**About The Job**
 Google Cloud’s mission is to make every business successful through AI by combining cutting\-edge technology, infrastructure, and talent. AI/ML software engineers in Cloud bridge the gap between pioneering models and a massive product vehicle reaching billions. Our talent density and AI\-powered tools drive rapid development, rooted in a culture of empowerment and a bias to action. In this role, you aren’t just building technology; you’re shaping the frontier of enterprise and driving the evolution of advanced models.
   

  

 As the Managing Director for Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will lead the strategic outlook and execution for an organization of expert builder\-consultants dedicated to the "last mile" integration of Google’s AI suite across EMEA enterprises. You will act as an executive sponsor, guiding large and complex customers through the transition from AI experimentation to scalable, production\-grade deployments of Google Cloud’s suite of AI solutions. You will utilize a blend of deep technical architecting and high\-level commercial acumen to ensure that enterprise\-wide implementations—from sophisticated multi\-agent orchestration to holistic workspace integration—deliver transformational business value and drive sustained, massive\-scale platform consumption.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Direct FDE to own the technical lifecycle of major AI oriented projects, accelerating the move to fully integrated, secure production environments on customer infrastructure.
* Establish definitive best practices for connecting AI Solution orchestration with complex hybrid enterprise architectures and legacy databases.
* Partner with sales and tech leadership to define engagement requirements, deploying talent to high\-stakes strategic AI accounts and advising C\-suite stakeholders.
* Serve as an executive bridge to Product Engineering, converting field insights from enterprise deployments into critical roadmap features for Vertex AI, Gemini Enterprise, and other AI enabled enterprise solutions.
* Foster a high\-performance culture, recruiting and retaining industry talent at the forefront of GenAI and agentic workflows.
